analyst.pt.why: Golo cedo que aumenta a probabilidade de vitória dos Benchwarmers de 44,2% para 68,3% (+24,1%), mudando o equilíbrio do jogo.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Sequência estruturada (9 passes) antes do canto; Lozano converte uma ocasião de alto valor. Sem este golo, a probabilidade de vitória cairia para 0,442.

home-fan.en.title: Goal! Lozano strikes
home-fan.en.body: P. Lozano nods Benchwarmers ahead from a corner after O. Faye’s set-up — Carb Loaders 0-1 Benchwarmers FC. Tough early blow for us.
home-fan.en.why: This early corner goal pushed Benchwarmers' win chance up by 24 points (to 68%), shifting control and forcing Carb Loaders to chase.

home-fan.fr.title: But ! Lozano ouvre le score
home-fan.fr.body: P. Lozano marque sur corner, Benchwarmers FC mène 0-1. Super début pour eux — Carb Loaders doivent réagir vite.
home-fan.fr.why: Ce but tôt augmente la probabilité de victoire adverse de 24 points, change le momentum et met Carb Loaders en retard.

home-fan.es.title: ¡Gol rival temprano!
home-fan.es.body: P. Lozano marca tras un córner. Benchwarmers FC se adelanta 0-1; el gol llegó tras una jugada preparada y un pase clave de O. Faye.
home-fan.es.why: Esto cambia mucho: Benchwarmers sube su opción de ganar del 44% al 68% (+24 puntos).

home-fan.pt.title: Golo! Lozano abre o marcador
home-fan.pt.body: P. Lozano marcou após canto e colocou os Benchwarmers na frente. O passe foi de O. Faye — jogo vira para os visitantes.
home-fan.pt.why: Este golo cedo dá vantagem decisiva aos Benchwarmers e aumentou a probabilidade de vitória deles em 24 pontos (agora 68%).

away-fan.en.title: Lozano opens the scoring
away-fan.en.body: What a start! P. Lozano heads (well, foot) home from a corner after calm build-up. Benchwarmers lead 1-0 — perfect opener.
away-fan.en.why: This early corner goal gave Benchwarmers a big boost, lifting win chance by 24 points to 68%, changing the game's balance.

away-fan.fr.title: But ! P. Lozano ouvre le score
away-fan.fr.body: Corner bien travaillé, O. Faye trouve Lozano qui conclut du pied. Benchwarmers FC mène 0-1 et contrôle le jeu.
away-fan.fr.why: Ce but précoce donne une avance décisive et augmente la probabilité de victoire de Benchwarmers FC de 24 points (à 68 %).

away-fan.es.title: ¡Gol de P. Lozano!
away-fan.es.body: Corner bien ejecutado: O. Faye asistió y Lozano remató con el pie para el 0-1. Benchwarmers manda desde temprano.
away-fan.es.why: Este gol tempranero sube la probabilidad de victoria del equipo en 24 puntos, cambiando el control del partido a su favor.

away-fan.pt.title: GOOOL! Lozano abre o marcador
away-fan.pt.body: P. Lozano marcou de pé após um canto bem trabalhado. Benchwarmers na frente — 0-1.
away-fan.pt.why: Gol cedo que deixa o Benchwarmers com grande vantagem: aumentou a chance de vitória em 24 pontos, mudando o rumo do jogo.

player-focus.en.title: Benchwarmers take the lead

player-focus.en.why: This early corner goal lifts Benchwarmers' win chance by 24 percentage points (now 68%), shifting control away from Carb Loaders.

player-focus.fr.title: BUT ! P. Lozano ouvre le score

player-focus.fr.why: Ce but d’ouverture donne à Benchwarmers une grosse avance — leur chance de gagner monte de 24 points, changeant l’équilibre du match.

player-focus.es.title: ¡Gol de P. Lozano!
player-focus.es.body: Lozano remata de volea tras córner y Benchwarmers FC se pone 0-1. O. Faye puso la asistencia. Cambio grande en el partido.
player-focus.es.why: Este gol tempranero sube la posibilidad de victoria rival en 24 puntos: ahora están mucho más cerca de ganar.

player-focus.pt.title: Golo! Lozano abre o marcador

signal.headline: Benchwarmers FC's press pays off: ball won high up and a shot within 7 seconds.

insight.why_it_matters: Benchwarmers FC’s high press immediately turned possession into a low-xG shot within 7 seconds, sustaining control and keeping Carb Loaders pinned back in the 17th minute.
insight.analyst_note: A pressing win high up (pressures 14, build_up_s 7) produced a quick two-pass sequence and a 0.02 xG attempt; it exemplifies how short, intense pressing sequences are being used to convert possession dominance into concrete attacking chances.

commentary.line: Brilliant pressing from Benchwarmers FC — P. Lozano steals it high and S. Hendriks fires off a 22.7m effort within 7 seconds, testing Carb Loaders already in the 17th.

analyst.en.title: High press → quick chance
analyst.en.body: Benchwarmers’ press produced a turnover and, after two passes in 7s, S. Hendriks fired a 0.02 chance. Pressure kept Carb Loaders pinned and sustained control.
analyst.en.why: The high press turned possession into a shot within 7s, keeping Carb Loaders under pressure and preserving Benchwarmers’ control — a clear momentum-sustaining action.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Pressing win high up (14 pressures) led to a two-pass sequence in 7s and a 0.02 xG shot—shows how short, intense pressing converts possession dominance into chances.

analyst.fr.title: Press haut: tir rapide
analyst.fr.body: Pressing haut de Benchwarmers FC => récupération et tir en 7s après 2 passes. Contrôle maintenu, Carb Loaders acculés.
analyst.fr.why: Le pressing a transformé la possession en une occasion (tir 0,02) en 7s, renforçant le contrôle de Benchwarmers FC et maintenant la pression offensive.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Récupération haute (pressures 14, build_up_s 7) puis séquence en 2 passes menant à un tir xG 0,02 : pressing court et intense converti en occasion.

analyst.es.title: Press alta y tiro rápido
analyst.es.body: Benchwarmers FC recupera alto y, tras 2 pases en 7 s, S. Hendriks dispara (0.02 xG). Mantienen control y fuerzan a Carb Loaders a retroceder.
analyst.es.why: La presión inmediata creó un tiro en 7 segundos, consolidando control y manteniendo a Carb Loaders encerrado, aumentando la probabilidad de mantener ventaja.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Victoria de presión alta (presiones 14, build_up_s 7) generó una secuencia de dos pases y un intento de 0.02 xG; muestra la efectividad de presiones cortas e intensas.

analyst.pt.title: Pressão alta rende remate
analyst.pt.body: Benchwarmers FC recupera a bola no terço ofensivo e, em 7s e 2 passes, S. Hendriks dispara um remate de pé (xG 0,02). Mantém controlo e pressão sobre Carb Loaders.
analyst.pt.why: Mostra como pressão curta e intensa transforma posse em oportunidade concreta, mantendo o adversário encostado e o controlo de jogo.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Vitória de pressing alto (14 pressões, build_up_s 7) levou a sequência de 2 passes e remate com xG 0,02 — padrão de converter domínio posicional em ocasiões.

away-fan.en.title: Press leads to quick shot
away-fan.en.body: Benchwarmers press wins the ball high, two quick passes and S. Hendriks fires a shot inside 7 seconds — dangerous move that keeps us in control.
away-fan.en.why: Shows our press turning possession into an immediate chance, keeping Carb Loaders pinned and momentum with us.

away-fan.fr.title: Press payant, tir rapide
away-fan.fr.body: Benchwarmers FC récupère haut, deux passes et un tir en 7 s — S. Hendriks frappe à la suite. Ça garde Carb Loaders sous pression.
away-fan.fr.why: La récupération haute a créé un tir faible mais rapide en 7 s, maintenant le contrôle et la pression sur Carb Loaders.

away-fan.es.title: Press alto y tiro rápido
away-fan.es.body: Benchwarmers ganó el balón cerca del rival y, en 7 segundos y solo dos pases, S. Hendriks lanzó un disparo. Controlamos el juego y apretamos arriba.
away-fan.es.why: Esto mantiene al rival atrás y convierte posesión en una ocasión inmediata, sosteniendo el control del partido.

away-fan.pt.title: Pressão dá resultado rápido
away-fan.pt.body: Benchwarmers vence a bola alto e, em 7s, S. Hendriks dispara. Mantemos o controle e deixamos o adversário acuado.
away-fan.pt.why: Importa porque a pressão virou posse em chance imediata (7s), mantendo o time no comando e o rival sob pressão.

This possession pattern protects the lead and frustrates opponent transitions.

analyst.en.analyst_note: Phase shows control: 3.6 passes/possession, low turnovers (2) and chaos_index 53.1 — managing tempo and blunting Carb Loaders' transitions.

analyst.fr.body: 69% de possession et 45 passes récentes: Benchwarmers gère le match, garde Carb Loaders bas et protège son avance 0-1.

analyst.pt.title: Benchwarmers controlam jogo
analyst.pt.body: 69% de posse e 45 passes nos últimos 5 minutos — mantêm o 1-0 e sufocam o Carb Loaders, evitando transições perigosas.

away-fan.en.title: Benchwarmers in control
away-fan.en.body: Great spell — 69% possession and 45 passes in the last 5 minutes, keeping Carb Loaders pinned while we hold the 1-0 lead.

away-fan.fr.title: On tient le coup !

away-fan.pt.body: Benchwarmers tem 69% de posse e 45 passes nos últimos 5 minutos. Mantemos o 1-0 e damos pouco espaço ao Carb Loaders.

signal.headline: D. Assunção threads a pass into the box for P. Lozano.

insight.why_it_matters: Assunção’s 26.5m defence-splitting pass under pressure created Benchwarmers’ clearest chance and helped convert possession dominance into a goal opportunity that sustained their 0-1 lead at 23'.
insight.analyst_note: The pass required high technical execution (94.3) while pressed, showing Benchwarmers’ ability to play precise long connectors from midfield; it complements their 65.0% possession and 156 passes to convert territorial control into a high-quality chance for P. Lozano.

commentary.line: D. Assunção, under pressure, threads a brilliant 26.5m pass into the box — P. Lozano darts in, already lively after that 14' opener.

away-fan.en.title: Lovely defence-splitting pass
away-fan.en.body: Assunção, under pressure, threaded a 26.5m pass into the box that set up Lozano’s clear chance — helped turn our possession into a goal threat and kept the lead.
away-fan.en.why: It turned calm control into a real chance, helping Benchwarmers keep the 0-1 lead and stay on top.

away-fan.fr.title: Super passe d'Assunção
away-fan.fr.body: Assunção a percé la défense avec une passe longue sous pression pour Lozano — l’action la plus nette qui a mené au but, gardant notre avance 1-0.
away-fan.fr.why: Cette passe longue compliquée a transformé notre domination en une vraie occasion, aidant à préserver l’avance 1-0.

away-fan.es.title: Pase mágico de Assunção
away-fan.es.body: Bajo presión, D. Assunção lanzó un pase de 26.5 m dentro del área para P. Lozano — la mejor ocasión que creó Benchwarmers hasta ahora.
away-fan.es.why: Ese pase bajo presión transformó la posesión en una oportunidad clara y mantuvo el 0-1 a favor de Benchwarmers.

away-fan.pt.title: Passe que abriu caminho
away-fan.pt.body: Assunção, pressionado, meteu um passe de 26,5 m para Lozano dentro da área — lance que criou a oportunidade mais clara e manteve o Benchwarmers na frente.
away-fan.pt.why: Porque esse passe sob pressão transformou posse em oportunidade clara, ajudando a manter o 0-1 favorável aos Benchwarmers.

signal.headline: Benchwarmers FC take control: 63% possession and 4.1 passes per possession over the last 5 minutes.

insight.why_it_matters: Benchwarmers FC’s sustained control (63% possession, 4.1 passes/possession) consolidates their 0-1 lead and makes Carb Loaders’ comeback unlikely given the current match state and win probabilities.
insight.analyst_note: Their higher pass accuracy (0.846) and heavier ball circulation—rather than long balls—reduces transition risk and forces Carb Loaders to chase (PPDA 5.5 vs 7.4), increasing defensive fatigue and protecting the one-goal advantage.

commentary.line: Benchwarmers FC boss the ball — 63% possession, crisp 4.1-pass possessions — and look comfortable protecting Lozano’s early strike as Carb Loaders struggle to respond.

analyst.en.title: Benchwarmers control spell

analyst.en.why: Sustained control consolidates the lead and makes a Carb Loaders comeback much less likely given current win probabilities.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Higher pass accuracy (0.846) and short passing (long ball share 14%) cut transition risk, raise opponents’ defensive work-rate (PPDA 5.5 vs 7.4), and protect the one-goal margin.

analyst.es.body: 63% de posesión y 4.1 pases por posesión en el último tramo; mantienen el balón y gestionan el 0-1 con paciencia y circulación rápida.

analyst.es.analyst_note: Mayor acierto de pase (0.846) y circulación de balón en lugar de balones largos (0.14) baja el riesgo de transiciones; PPDA 5.5 vs 7.4, agotando al rival defensivamente.

analyst.pt.title: Benchwarmers control o jogo
analyst.pt.body: 63% de posse e 4,1 passes por posse nas últimas cinco minutos: estão a gerir o ritmo para proteger a vantagem de 1-0.

signal.headline: Momentum swings towards Carb Loaders.

insight.why_it_matters: Momentum has flipped heavily to Carb Loaders (momentum 91.9) at 32', signalling a sustained period where they can force chances despite trailing 0-1 — this swing reduces Benchwarmers FC's control in the match.
insight.analyst_note: The swing follows a chaotic phase (chaos_index 71.4) with high turnovers (3.2/min); Carb Loaders' increased pressures (30) and shorter passes per possession (3.9) are disrupting Benchwarmers' longer possession sequences (214 passes, 0.846 accuracy), creating transition chances despite lower overall possession.

commentary.line: After the early scare and Lozano's goal, Carb Loaders are rattling Benchwarmers—surging, pressing and suddenly dominating possession as the momentum rockets their way in the 32nd minute!

analyst.en.title: Carb Loaders turnaround
analyst.en.body: Momentum spikes to 91.9 — Carb Loaders now forcing sustained pressure despite trailing 0-1. High chaos and turnovers are creating transition chances that cut into Benchwarmers’ control.
analyst.en.why: This swing gives Carb Loaders a sustained window to create chances, reducing Benchwarmers’ match control and raising comeback probability.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Swing follows chaos_index 71.4 and 3.2 turnovers/min. Carb Loaders’ 30 pressures and 3.9 passes/possession are disrupting Benchwarmers’ 214 passes (0.846 accuracy), yielding transitions.

analyst.fr.title: Basculement net vers Carb Loaders
analyst.fr.body: Carb Loaders dominent le jeu à 32' malgré le 0‑1 : pressing plus intense et possessions courtes créent des occasions en transition, réduisant le contrôle des Benchwarmers.
analyst.fr.why: Ce tournant (momentum 91,9) offre à Carb Loaders une période soutenue pour créer des opportunités et affaiblit le contrôle adverse.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Phase chaotique (indice 71,4) avec 3,2 pertes/min. Carb Loaders : 30 pressings, 3,9 passes/possession; Benchwarmers : 214 passes à 84,6 % — transitions favorables aux locaux.

analyst.es.title: Momentum volcado a Carb Loaders
analyst.es.body: A los 32' Carb Loaders dominan la fase: presión alta y posesiones cortas que generan oportunidades pese a ir 0-1 abajo.
analyst.es.why: Este giro (momentum 91.9) crea un periodo sostenido para forzar ocasiones y frena el control previo de Benchwarmers FC.
analyst.es.analyst_note: El cambio ocurre en fase caótica (índice 71.4) con 3.2 pérdidas/min; 30 presiones y 3.9 pases/posesión de Carb Loaders rompen las secuencias largas de Benchwarmers (214 pases, 0.846).

analyst.pt.body: Momento pingue-pongue: Carb Loaders domina a posse perigosa e pressiona alto, criando condições para chances apesar de perder 0-1.

home-fan.en.title: Carb Loaders taking over

home-fan.es.title: ¡Carb Loaders viene fuerte!

away-fan.fr.title: Carb Loaders prennent l'ascendant
away-fan.fr.body: À la 32e, l'élan bascule fort vers Carb Loaders — ils vont pousser pour créer des chances malgré le score (0-1). Restez attentif, le match devient nerveux.

signal.headline: Carb Loaders break at speed from their own half; I. Cardoso gets a shot away.

insight.why_it_matters: This rapid counter gave Carb Loaders a clear chance (xG 0.01) that briefly disrupted Benchwarmers’ dominance and showed they can punish transitions despite 35% possession and poor build-up. The sequence reduced momentum deficit in a chaotic phase.
insight.analyst_note: A three-pass break from their own half (build_up_passes 3) produced a high-speed outlet led by M. Lindemann; Cardoso’s shot came from transition rather than sustained possession, highlighting Carb Loaders’ reliance on quick counters when under passing pressure (ppda 6.6).

commentary.line: What a break! Carb Loaders burst forward from their own half, M. Lindemann slips it through and I. Cardoso fires — but it whistles just wide at 35 minutes.

analyst.en.title: Quick break, top speed
analyst.en.body: Three-pass counter from their half. M. Lindemann fed I. Cardoso, who fired a low-xG shot after a 25.7 m run at 32.5 km/h — a clear transition threat despite limited possession.
analyst.en.why: It briefly dented Benchwarmers’ control and cut the momentum gap during a chaotic phase, showing Carb Loaders can threaten on fast transitions.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Counter came from 3 build-up passes; Cardoso’s shot was transition-born, underlining reliance on rapid outlets versus sustained build (ppda 6.6).

analyst.fr.title: Contre rapide depuis leur camp
analyst.fr.body: Carb Loaders lancent une percée en 3 passes; M. Lindemann lance I. Cardoso qui frappe à haute vitesse après 25,7 m.
analyst.fr.why: Cette contre-attaque a créé une vraie occasion (xG 0,01) et a brièvement réduit le déficit de momentum dans une phase chaotique.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Break en 3 passes depuis leur moitié (build_up_passes 3). Sortie rapide menée par Lindemann; tir de Cardoso en transition, montrant dépendance aux contres sous pression (ppda 6,6).

analyst.es.title: Contra rápida de Carb Loaders
analyst.es.body: Tres pases desde su campo, Lindemann libera a Cardoso que alcanza 32.5 km/h y dispara tras 25.7 m; la oportunidad vino en transición, no en juego posicional.
analyst.es.why: La contra cortó momentáneamente la dominancia rival y redujo el déficit de momentum en una fase caótica, mostrando su peligro al romper líneas.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Ruptura de tres pases desde campo propio (build_up_passes 3). Salida rápida de Lindemann; disparo de Cardoso en transición, subrayando dependencia de contras con presión alta (ppda 6.6).

analyst.pt.title: Contra-ataque veloz dos Carb Loaders
analyst.pt.body: Rompida de 3 passes desde meio-campo; M. Lindemann lançou e I. Cardoso rematou a 103.1 km/h de transição, criando uma oportunidade clara.
analyst.pt.why: A jogada quebrou a autoridade do Benchwarmers e reduziu o défice de momentum numa fase caótica, mostrando eficácia nos contra-ataques rápidos.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Contra de três passes (build_up_passes 3), saída rápida de Lindemann; remate de Cardoso na transição, evidenciando dependência em contra-ataques sob pressão no passe (ppda 6.6).

home-fan.en.title: Blazing counter led to shot
home-fan.en.body: Carb Loaders raced from their own half — M. Lindemann fed I. Cardoso, who fired from long range. A quick moment that briefly shook Benchwarmers' control.
home-fan.en.why: It gave us a real chance despite being second best, cutting our momentum gap and showing we can hurt them on the break.

home-fan.fr.title: Break fulgurant de Carb Loaders
home-fan.fr.body: Carb Loaders partent en contre rapide depuis leur moitié, M. Lindemann lance I. Cardoso qui frappe vite du pied. Belle opportunité malgré la domination adverse.
home-fan.fr.why: Ça a montré qu’on peut punir les transitions et a réduit un peu l’élan adverse dans un moment chaotique.

home-fan.es.title: Rápida contra; tiro de Cardoso
home-fan.es.body: Carb Loaders rompieron desde su mitad: M. Lindemann asistió y I. Cardoso probó al arco tras un sprint de 25,7 m a 103 km/h. Fue una oportunidad clara que frenó un poco al rival.
home-fan.es.why: Importante: mostró que podemos castigar transiciones rápidas y cortó la racha del rival, recortando algo el impulso en un momento caótico.

home-fan.pt.title: Contra-ataque rápido dos Carb
home-fan.pt.body: Carb Loaders saem da própria metade; I. Cardoso remata rápido depois de passe de M. Lindemann. Grande velocidade e pressão para tentar empatar.
home-fan.pt.why: Mostrou que podemos assustar mesmo sem posse longa — diminuiu um pouco o domínio adversário e trouxe energia num momento caótico.

player-focus.en.title: Quick break, shot by Cardoso
player-focus.en.body: Cardoso raced 25.7 m at 32.5 km/h after Lindemann's pass and fired a low-xG shot. Small moment that showed Carb Loaders can hurt on the break.
player-focus.en.why: It briefly cut into Benchwarmers’ control and gave Carb Loaders a real chance from transition, easing the momentum gap in a chaotic spell.

player-focus.fr.title: Contre rapide de Cardoso
player-focus.fr.body: I. Cardoso part vite depuis sa moitié, fil à 32,5 km/h et frappe après la passe de M. Lindemann — belle chance même si peu probante.
player-focus.fr.why: Ça a cassé la domination adverse un instant et a réduit le coup de moins bien de l’équipe dans une phase chaotique.

player-focus.es.title: Contra rápida de Cardoso
player-focus.es.body: I. Cardoso remata tras un contraataque veloz iniciado por M. Lindemann; la jugada vino desde su campo y llevó peligro pese a poco balón.
player-focus.es.why: Esto mostró que Cardoso puede crear peligro en transiciones y cortó un poco la racha del rival, dando energía en una fase caótica.

player-focus.pt.title: Contra-ataque relâmpago
player-focus.pt.body: I. Cardoso recebe o passe de M. Lindemann, avança 25,7 m a 103,1 km/h e dispara com o pé — boa chance num momento caótico, apesar do fraco controlo de bola.
player-focus.pt.why: Mostrou que o Carb Loaders pode assustar em transições e cortou um pouco a vantagem do Benchwarmers numa fase caótica do jogo.

signal.headline: Carb Loaders' press pays off: ball won high up and a shot within 2 seconds.

insight.why_it_matters: Winning the ball high and shooting within 2 seconds shows the Carb Loaders can create instant danger through aggressive pressing, briefly disrupting Benchwarmers' control when momentum is against them.
insight.analyst_note: This high turnover (one of 3 high_turnovers) came from a successful press leading to a very quick transition chance; Lindemann’s shot after 2 seconds demonstrates effective pressure-to-shot sequencing but low xG highlights the chance was rushed and not fully-constructed.

commentary.line: Carb Loaders' press wins it high — M. Lindemann smashes a 13‑metre shot within two seconds, a frantic riposte to Benchwarmers' earlier high turnovers.

analyst.en.title: High press, instant shot
analyst.en.body: Carb Loaders win the ball high and M. Lindemann fires inside 2 seconds — quick transition after aggressive pressing, but the chance is low-quality.
analyst.en.why: Showed they can disrupt Benchwarmers and create instant danger; briefly shifted momentum despite being behind.
analyst.en.analyst_note: One of three high turnovers: press-produced turnover → 2s transition shot. Effective pressure-to-shot sequencing, but Lindemann’s 0.07 xG shows the chance was rushed and low quality.

analyst.fr.title: Turnover haut : tir immédiat
analyst.fr.body: Pressing payant des Carb Loaders : récupération près du but adverse et tir en 2s par M. Lindemann, tentative rapide mais peu construite.
analyst.fr.why: Montre que le pressing peut créer un danger instantané et perturber Benchwarmers, réduisant brièvement leur contrôle de la rencontre.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Un des 3 turnovers hauts, press réussi menant à une transition très rapide ; le tir en 2s montre la séquence pression‑tir mais xG faible signale une occasion précipitée.

analyst.es.title: Presión que genera tiro rápido
analyst.es.body: Recuperación alta del Carb Loaders y tiro de M. Lindemann en 2 s tras la pérdida rival; ejemplo claro de presión que crea ocasiones inmediatas.
analyst.es.why: Mostró que la presión alta puede romper el control rival y producir una ocasión inmediata cuando el partido iba en contra.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Recuperación alta (1 de 3) que generó transición inmediata; el tiro de Lindemann en 2 s evidencia la secuencia presión‑tiro, pero xG 0.07 indica ocasión precipitada y de baja calidad.

analyst.pt.title: Press alto gera chute rápido
analyst.pt.body: Lindemann recupera e remata em 2s — pressão eficaz, chance rápida mas de baixa qualidade.
analyst.pt.why: Mostra que a Carb Loaders conseguem criar perigo instantâneo com pressão alta, interrompendo o domínio adversário e revertendo momento momentaneamente.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Recuperação alta (1/3 turnovers altos) levou a transição imediata; sequência pressão→remate em 2s mostra execução, mas xG 0,07 indica oportunidade apressada e pouco trabalhada.

home-fan.en.title: Press pays off — quick chance
home-fan.en.body: Carb Loaders win the ball high and M. Lindemann fires a shot just 2 seconds later. Close call that lifts the team and stuns Benchwarmers for a moment.
home-fan.en.why: Shows we can make danger instantly by pressing; briefly disrupted Benchwarmers’ control when momentum was against us.

home-fan.fr.title: Pressing payant, tir rapide
home-fan.fr.body: Carb Loaders ont volé le ballon et M. Lindemann a tiré en 2 secondes — pression qui crée du danger même si on est menés 0-1.
home-fan.fr.why: Montre qu’en pressant haut on peut surprendre et créer des occasions instantanées, donnant un coup d’espoir malgré le score.

home-fan.es.title: Press que da peligro
home-fan.es.body: Recuperan arriba y Lindemann saca un disparo en 2 segundos. Fue rápida y asustó al rival pese a no entrar.
home-fan.es.why: Muestra que presionando fuerte pueden crear peligro instantáneo y frenar el control rival justo cuando vamos por detrás.

home-fan.pt.title: Pressão dá chance imediata
home-fan.pt.body: Carb Loaders recuperam a bola alto e M. Lindemann dispara em 2s — um remate rápido que mostrou perigo apesar de não entrar.
home-fan.pt.why: Mostra que, mesmo atrás no placar, a equipa pode criar perigo instantâneo com pressão alta e quebrar o controlo adversário.

player-focus.en.title: Quick press, instant shot
player-focus.en.body: Lindemann wins the ball high and fires a shot two seconds later — a sharp press that made Benchwarmers scramble and gave us a real chance to equalise.
player-focus.en.why: Shows Carb Loaders can turn pressure into immediate danger, briefly shifting momentum and creating a fast chance when we needed it.

player-focus.fr.title: Pressing payant, tir immédiat
player-focus.fr.body: M. Lindemann récupère haut, tire en 2s — frappe rapide mais sans but. Belle énergie du pressing pour créer du danger instantané.
player-focus.fr.why: Montre que le pressing peut perturber Benchwarmers et créer une occasion rapide, un petit coup de boost alors que le momentum est contre nous.

player-focus.es.title: Press alto y tiro rápido
player-focus.es.body: M. Lindemann recupera arriba y dispara en 2 segundos: peligro inmediato, balón al pie y velocidad pura. Un soplo de vida cuando vamos por detrás.
player-focus.es.why: Demuestra que presionando podemos crear peligro instantáneo y romper el control rival, aunque fue una oportunidad apresurada.

player-focus.pt.title: Press alta gera remate
player-focus.pt.body: M. Lindemann recuperou a bola alto e atirou em 2s — pressão rápida que criou perigo instantâneo, mesmo sem golo.
player-focus.pt.why: Mostra que, mesmo atrás no marcador, a equipa pode forçar erros e criar ocasiões rápidas que mudam o ritmo do jogo.

signal.headline: The game turns chaotic: 3.4 turnovers a minute and 19% long balls over the last 5 minutes.

insight.why_it_matters: The match has slipped into open chaos at 39', with frequent turnovers and more long balls, stalling Carb Loaders' comeback and preserving Benchwarmers FC's 0-1 lead during a key late-first-half phase.
insight.analyst_note: High turnover rate (3.4/min) and short possessions (3.4 passes) force direct play—Benchwarmers' superior possession (65.2%) and extra corners (5) let them absorb the disorder while Carb Loaders' lower pass accuracy (0.667) and 3 high turnovers limit their ability to build sustained pressure.

commentary.line: It's absolute mayhem — three-plus turnovers a minute, long balls flying, and Benchwarmers still clinging to a 1-0 lead as Carb Loaders search for order.

analyst.en.title: Chaos takes over match
analyst.en.body: At 39' the game is chaotic: 3.4 turnovers per minute, short possessions (3.4 passes) and 19% long balls—Benchwarmers absorb it and keep their 0-1 lead.
analyst.en.why: This chaos halts Carb Loaders’ build-up and helps Benchwarmers protect their lead into halftime.
analyst.en.analyst_note: High turnover rate (3.4/min) and short possessions (3.4 passes) force direct play. Benchwarmers’ 65.2% possession and five corners let them absorb disorder; Carb Loaders’ 66.7% pass accuracy (0.667) and three high turnovers limit pressure.

analyst.fr.title: Match devenu chaotique
analyst.fr.body: 39': phase de chaos — nombreux turnovers et jeu direct qui freinent la relance des Carb Loaders; Benchwarmers tiennent leur avance 0-1.
analyst.fr.why: Le chaos (beaucoup de pertes et plus de longs ballons) empêche Carb Loaders de lancer une vraie réaction et maintient l’avantage de Benchwarmers.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Taux élevé de turnovers (3,4/min) et possessions courtes (3,4 passes) poussent au jeu direct. Benchwarmers, 65,2% de possession et 5 corners, absorbent le désordre; Carb Loaders limitée par 66,7% de passes réussies et 3 turnovers élevés.

analyst.es.title: Juego en caos abierto
analyst.es.body: Alta pérdida de balón y juego directo: 3.4 pérdidas por minuto y solo 3.4 pases por posesión, con 19% de pelotas largas. Benchwarmers mantienen el 0-1.
analyst.es.why: Este caos frena la remontada de Carb Loaders y ayuda a Benchwarmers a conservar su ventaja justo antes del descanso.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Tasa alta de pérdidas (3.4/min) y posesiones cortas (3.4 pases) fuerzan juego directo; Benchwarmers (65.2% posesión, 5 corners) absorben el desorden, Carb Loaders tienen baja precisión (66.7%) y 3 pérdidas altas.

analyst.pt.title: Jogo em modo caótico
analyst.pt.body: Alta perda de bola e jogo direto: 3,4 turnovers/min e 19% de bolas longas. Benchwarmers mantêm 0-1 graças à posse superior e domínio territorial.
analyst.pt.why: O caos travou a reação dos Carb Loaders e protegeu o 0-1 do Benchwarmers quando o primeiro tempo se fechava.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Turnovers altos (3,4/min) e posse curta (3,4 passes) forçam jogo direto. Benchwarmers absorvem o caos com 65,2% de posse e 5 cantos; Carb Loaders têm 3 high turnovers e 66,7% de acerto de passe.

signal.headline: I. Cardoso unleashes a 110 km/h strike from 22 m.

insight.why_it_matters: A 110.1 km/h free-kick from 22.3 m by I. Cardoso was a high-quality, low-xG attempt (xg 0.01) that offered Carb Loaders a quick route back into the game while they trail 0-1 at 39'.
insight.analyst_note: Although the shot's xG is low, the free-kick bypassed prolonged possession-based build-up (build_up_passes 2, build_up_s 22) and created an immediate chance in a chaotic phase (chaos_index 65.0), which suits Carb Loaders' need to convert set-piece opportunities while trailing.

commentary.line: I. Cardoso thunders a 110 km/h free‑kick from 22 m — a wild, desperate sally as Carb Loaders chase momentum but still trail 0-1 at 39'.

home-fan.en.title: Cardoso's thunderous free-kick
home-fan.en.body: I. Cardoso smashed a 110 km/h free-kick from 22 m — huge effort that almost forced Carb Loaders back into the game while down 0-1.
home-fan.en.why: A fierce, quick set-piece chance that gave Carb Loaders a real moment to level the score when they needed it most.

home-fan.fr.title: Super coup franc de Cardoso
home-fan.fr.body: I. Cardoso frappe à 110 km/h depuis 22 m : une tentative puissante qui aurait pu ramener l'équipe au score alors qu’on est menés 0-1.
home-fan.fr.why: Un tir puissant et direct qui a offert une chance rapide pour revenir au score, important vu qu’on est déjà menés 0-1.

home-fan.es.title: ¡Disparo bestial de Cardoso!
home-fan.es.body: I. Cardoso lanzó un libre directo tremendo a 110 km/h desde 22 m. No entró, pero fue una opción clara para recortar el 0-1 antes del descanso.
home-fan.es.why: Un tiro potente y rápido que dio a Carb Loaders una vía directa para volver al partido cuando iban perdiendo 0-1.

home-fan.pt.title: Tiro incrível de I. Cardoso
home-fan.pt.body: Livre direto a 110 km/h de 22 m — quase empata! Um remate forte que trouxe perigo imediato enquanto estamos 0-1 aos 39'.
home-fan.pt.why: Importante porque foi uma forma rápida de tentar empatar sem tocar muito na bola — trouxe perigo num momento caótico do jogo.

player-focus.en.title: Cardoso's thunderous free-kick
player-focus.en.body: I. Cardoso lashes a 110 km/h free-kick from 22 m — a fierce, immediate chance that nearly pulled Carb Loaders level while they trail 0-1.
player-focus.en.why: A raw, quick route back into the game — a big chance from a set play when we needed one, despite low scoring odds.

player-focus.fr.title: Super frappe de Cardoso
player-focus.fr.body: I. Cardoso tire un coup franc puissant à 110 km/h de 22 m — une grosse occasion rapide pour revenir au score malgré un faible xG.
player-focus.fr.why: Moment important : une chance directe pour égaliser alors qu’on est menés 0-1, vite et sans longue construction.

player-focus.es.title: ¡Disparo bestial de Cardoso!
player-focus.es.body: I. Cardoso lanzó una falta a 22 m a 110 km/h. Fue una oportunidad rápida para meternos de nuevo en el partido, aunque no tuvo fortuna.
player-focus.es.why: Un tiro potente desde la falta dio a Carb Loaders una vía directa para empatar cuando íbamos 0-1 — cambio inmediato de peligro.

player-focus.pt.title: Remate violento de I. Cardoso
player-focus.pt.body: Livre direto a 110 km/h de 22 m — um lance rápido e perigoso que quase mudou o jogo enquanto estávamos a perder 0-1.
player-focus.pt.why: Um remate forte e direto que deu à equipa uma rota rápida para empatar, importante porque reduz a desvantagem num momento caótico.

signal.headline: M. Lindemann threads a pass into the box for I. Cardoso.

insight.why_it_matters: Lindemann’s defence-splitting pass created Carb Loaders’ clearest chance early in the half, keeping them in the game while trailing 0–1 and slightly reducing a bleak 0.108 win probability.
insight.analyst_note: A high-difficulty, 44.1m line-breaking ball from Lindemann (key_passes 1) bypassed Benchwarmers’ press and freed Cardoso for three shots in the half; it shows Carb Loaders rely on individual passing quality to create versus opponent’s dominant possession (34.8% vs 65.2%).

commentary.line: Early in the second half M. Lindemann threads a brilliant 44m pass—I. Cardoso races onto it, another dangerous opening for the chasing Carb Loaders.

home-fan.en.title: Lovely long ball
home-fan.en.body: Lindemann split their defence with a brilliant 44m pass to Cardoso — the best chance so far, keeping us alive at 0–1.
home-fan.en.why: Kept Carb Loaders in the game early in the half and nudged our win chances up from a very low place.

home-fan.fr.title: Passe parfaite de Lindemann
home-fan.fr.body: M. Lindemann envoie une longue passe qui libère I. Cardoso dans la surface — la meilleure occasion des Carb Loaders en début de seconde mi-temps.
home-fan.fr.why: Garde l’équipe dans le coup après le but encaissé, réduisant un peu la probabilité de perdre (0,108).

home-fan.es.title: Pase que parte la defensa
home-fan.es.body: M. Lindemann clavó un pase largo y preciso que dejó a I. Cardoso solo en el área. Fue la mejor ocasión del equipo al inicio del segundo tiempo.
home-fan.es.why: Mantuvo viva la esperanza del Carb Loaders al crear la ocasión más clara y mejorar un poco nuestras opciones de ganar.

home-fan.pt.title: Passe que abriu perigo
home-fan.pt.body: M. Lindemann colocou uma bola longa perfeita para I. Cardoso na área — a melhor chance do início da segunda parte. Cardoso ainda atirou três vezes no primeiro tempo.
home-fan.pt.why: Manteve-nos na luta — diminuiu um pouco a probabilidade de perder e trouxe esperança para virar o jogo.

player-focus.en.title: Cardoso set up — great pass
player-focus.en.body: M. Lindemann slipped a brilliant long pass that freed I. Cardoso in the box — the clearest chance so far as Carb Loaders chase an equaliser.
player-focus.en.why: Kept us in the game while 0–1 down and nudged our win chance up a bit — showed we can still create clear chances.

player-focus.fr.title: Passe verticale de Lindemann
player-focus.fr.body: Super passe de M. Lindemann qui ouvre la surface pour I. Cardoso — occasion la plus claire du début de la seconde mi-temps, Carb Loaders restent dans le match malgré le score.
player-focus.fr.why: Ça garde Carb Loaders en vie après l’ouverture du score et améliore un peu leurs chances de revenir au score.

player-focus.es.title: Pase milimétrico de Lindemann
player-focus.es.body: Lindemann clavó un pase entre líneas de 44.1 m que dejó a Cardoso solo en el área — la mejor ocasión temprana del segundo tiempo para empatar.
player-focus.es.why: Mantuvo viva la esperanza: redujo un poco la probabilidad de pérdida al crear la ocasión más clara cuando íbamos 0-1.

player-focus.pt.title: Passe filtrado de M. Lindemann
player-focus.pt.body: Lindemann achou Cardoso com um passe longo perfeito dentro da área — a melhor chance dos Carb Loaders no início do 2º tempo. Cardoso finalizou três vezes na 1ª parte.
player-focus.pt.why: Mantém-nos vivos no jogo: reduziu um pouco a probabilidade de derrota quando estávamos a perder 0–1.

signal.headline: Momentum swings towards Carb Loaders.

insight.why_it_matters: Carb Loaders have seized momentum at 51'—momentum rose to 66.6 after a run of swings—giving them a stronger platform to chase the 0-1 deficit when Benchwarmers had controlled early on.
insight.analyst_note: The shift reflects Carb Loaders increasing successful high presses (47 pressures) and forcing turnovers after a period of Benchwarmers control; with Benchwarmers' PPDA at 5.3, Carb Loaders must sustain these pressure sequences to disrupt long passing chains and create clear chances.

commentary.line: Carb Loaders are finally building — pressing high, probing after that frantic spell earlier, and momentum's shifted their way in the 51st minute.

analyst.en.title: Momentum shift to Carb Loaders
analyst.en.body: At 51' momentum jumps to 66.6 as Carb Loaders press higher and win more balls. They now have a clearer platform to chase the 0–1 deficit against Benchwarmers' earlier control.
analyst.en.why: This swing (momentum 66.6) gives Carb Loaders better chances to overturn the 0–1 score by sustaining high press sequences and forcing turnovers.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Carb Loaders raised successful high presses (47 pressures), forcing turnovers versus Benchwarmers' earlier control. With Benchwarmers' PPDA 5.3, sustained pressure is needed to break their passing chains and create clear chances.

analyst.fr.title: Inflexion en faveur de Carb Loaders
analyst.fr.body: À la 51', la dynamique bascule: Carb Loaders passent à 66,6 de momentum grâce à une montée du pressing et davantage de récupérations hautes. Chance réelle de revenir à 0-1.
analyst.fr.why: Ce basculement donne à Carb Loaders une plateforme plus solide pour revenir au score, réduisant l'avantage de Benchwarmers.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: La hausse vient d’un pressing plus efficace (47 pressions) et de turnovers forcés; avec le PPDA de Benchwarmers à 5,3, il faut prolonger ces séquences pour casser les enchaînements de passes longs.

analyst.es.title: Carb Loaders toma impulso
analyst.es.body: Al minuto 51 el impulso sube a 66.6: Carb Loaders aumentó la presión y amenaza la ventaja 0-1 de Benchwarmers FC.
analyst.es.why: Esto cambia la dinámica: les da a los Carb Loaders una plataforma más sólida para buscar el empate tras un primer tramo dominado por Benchwarmers.
analyst.es.analyst_note: El giro viene de más pressing exitoso (47 presiones) y robos; con PPDA de Benchwarmers 5.3, deben mantener secuencias de presión para romper sus cadenas de pase.

analyst.pt.title: Carb Loaders ganha momento
analyst.pt.body: A equipa sobe o ritmo: mais pressão alta e recuperação de bola dão plataforma para ir atrás do 0-1, apesar de terem só 35,1% de posse.
analyst.pt.why: Aos 51' o momentum subiu para 66,6 — virou a balança para Carb Loaders criarem mais ocasiões e reduzirem o défice.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: A subida deve-se a mais pressão alta (47) e roubos de bola que quebram a posse dos Benchwarmers; com PPDA 5,3, é preciso manter sequências para gerar oportunidades claras.

home-fan.en.title: Carb Loaders fight back
home-fan.en.body: At 51' momentum flipped to Carb Loaders (66.6). We’re driving now after a tense spell—time to press hard and chase that 0-1 score.
home-fan.en.why: This swing gives us a much better platform to chase the 0-1 score — momentum rose to 66.6 after earlier control by Benchwarmers.

home-fan.fr.title: Carb Loaders relancent le jeu
home-fan.fr.body: 51' : l'élan bascule pour nous — on pousse après une série de retournements. Plus d'occasions possibles pour revenir à 0-1.
home-fan.fr.why: Ce regain (élan 66,6) donne plus de chances de revenir au score en prenant l'initiative après une phase où l'adversaire contrôlait.

home-fan.es.title: Carb Loaders toma impulso
home-fan.es.body: Al 51' el juego cambia: Carb Loaders domina más y presiona, acercándose al 0-1. Ahora tienen mejor chance de empatar si mantienen la intensidad.

signal.headline: GOAL! P. Lozano scores for Benchwarmers FC. It's a brace! Carb Loaders 0-2 Benchwarmers FC.

insight.why_it_matters: Lozano’s second goal at 55' substantially increased Benchwarmers FC’s win chance — this strike widened the lead and raised their win probability by 0.241 (to 0.933), making a comeback for Carb Loaders extremely unlikely.
insight.analyst_note: The goal finished a 13-pass sequence that exemplified Benchwarmers’ control (64.5% possession, 401 passes); Faye’s key pass created a high-quality 2.8 m open-play finish for Lozano, converting a big-xG opportunity and converting sustained territorial dominance into a decisive score.

commentary.line: P. Lozano fires home from close range after O. Faye’s clever pass — his second of the night, and Benchwarmers double their lead in the 55th minute!

analyst.en.title: Lozano doubles lead
analyst.en.body: P. Lozano finishes a 13-pass move after O. Faye’s key pass, scoring from 2.8 m with his foot. Benchwarmers extend control and the lead.
analyst.en.why: This goal raised Benchwarmers’ win probability by 24.1 percentage points (to 93.3%), making Carb Loaders’ comeback extremely unlikely.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Goal capped a 13-pass sequence reflecting Benchwarmers’ control (64.5% possession, 401 passes). Faye’s assist created a high-quality 2.8 m open-play finish; Lozano converted a big-xG chance.

analyst.fr.title: But — P. Lozano double
analyst.fr.body: Lozano conclut une séquence de 13 passes et marque du pied sur une passe décisive d’O. Faye. Benchwarmers FC mène 0-2, contrôle la rencontre et creuse l’écart.
analyst.fr.why: Ce but augmente la probabilité de victoire de Benchwarmers de 24,1 points (passant à 93,3%), rendant le retour des Carb Loaders quasi impossible.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Le but conclut une séquence de 13 passes (64,5% de possession, 401 passes). Faye offre la passe clé pour une finition à 2,8 m, convertissant une grosse occasion (xG 0,78).

analyst.es.title: GOL: Lozano amplía ventaja
analyst.es.body: Lozano remata tras pase de O. Faye para firmar el 0-2. Finalizó una secuencia de 13 pases, convirtiendo una clara ocasión y sentenciando el partido.
analyst.es.why: Este gol aumentó la probabilidad de victoria del Benchwarmers de 0.692 a 0.933 (+0.241), haciendo la remontada casi imposible.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Gol que culmina una posesión de 13 pases; Benchwarmers dominó (64.5% posesión, 401 pases). Faye creó un disparo a 2.8 m que Lozano convirtió, capitalizando una ocasión de alto valor.

analyst.pt.title: Golo: P. Lozano confirma
analyst.pt.body: Lozano marca o segundo golo após sequência de 13 passes; Faye oferece o passe decisivo para um remate a 2,8 m. Benchwarmers FC amplia para 0-2 e praticamente assegura a vitória.
analyst.pt.why: Aumentou a probabilidade de vitória dos Benchwarmers de 69,2% para 93,3% — um salto de 24,1%, tornando o empate improvável.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Golo de uma sequência de 13 passes que reflete domínio (64,5% posse, 401 passes). Passe de Faye criou uma oportunidade de alta qualidade (xG 0,78) concluída por Lozano a 2,8 m em jogo aberto.

home-fan.en.why: This made Benchwarmers’ win much more likely, raising their win chance by 24.1% and leaving Carb Loaders with almost no path back.

home-fan.fr.title: But ! Lozano doublé

home-fan.fr.why: Ce but creuse l’écart et fait passer la probabilité de victoire des visiteurs de 69% à 93%, rendant le retour de Carb Loaders très improbable.

home-fan.es.title: GOL: Lozano lo sentencia

home-fan.es.why: Este gol aumentó la opción de victoria del rival en 24 puntos, dejando a Carb Loaders con muy pocas posibilidades de volver.

away-fan.es.title: ¡Gol de Lozano, doblete!

signal.headline: Benchwarmers FC take control: 60% possession and 3.8 passes per possession over the last 5 minutes.

insight.why_it_matters: Benchwarmers FC's sustained control (60% possession, 3.8 passes per possession) has stabilized the match and preserved a two-goal lead, keeping Carb Loaders pinned back and limiting their earlier momentum swing.
insight.analyst_note: Benchwarmers FC are reducing chaos (chaos_index 46.8) by cycling possession with higher pass accuracy (0.833) and lower long-ball use, forcing Carb Loaders into 2.6 turnovers/min and a low PPDA context (Benchwarmers PPDA 5.4) that protects the 0-2 game state.

commentary.line: Benchwarmers FC now boss the game — 64.5% possession, tidy 3.8 passes per trip as they squeeze Carb Loaders, who look pinned back after that earlier flurry.

analyst.en.analyst_note: Lower chaos (46.8) comes from cycling possession, high pass accuracy (0.833) and reduced long balls (0.18), producing 2.6 turnovers/min and a Benchwarmers PPDA of 5.4.

analyst.fr.title: Contrôle et gestion du score
analyst.fr.body: Benchwarmers FC stabilise le match : 60% de possession et 3,8 passes par possession, limitant les transitions adverses et protégeant leur avance de deux buts.
analyst.fr.why: Ce contrôle a neutralisé l’élan des Carb Loaders et maintenu l’avance 2-0, réduisant leurs occasions de retour.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Réduction du chaos (indice 46,8) via circulation précise (passes totales 401, précision 0,833) et moins de longues transmissions (18%), générant 2,6 pertes/min chez l’adversaire et un PPDA bas (5,4).

analyst.es.title: Control que asegura el 0-2
analyst.es.body: Benchwarmers domina: 60% de posesión y 3.8 pases por posesión, reduciendo riesgos y manteniendo a Carb Loaders encerrado atrás.
analyst.es.why: Esta posesión estable protege la ventaja de dos goles y apaga el impulso previo de Carb Loaders, manteniendo el partido controlado.

analyst.pt.title: Benchwarmers controlam o jogo
analyst.pt.body: 60% de posse e 3,8 passes por posse nas últimas 5 minutos: estão a gerir a vantagem de 2 goals e a manter Carb Loaders recuado.

signal.headline: Huge save! G. Ojeda denies L. Castagne (xG 0.72, 88 km/h).

insight.why_it_matters: Ojeda’s save prevented Carb Loaders from cutting the deficit — the shot (xG 0.72) would have increased Carb Loaders’ win chance from 0.017 to 0.067, swinging 0.05 win probability away from Benchwarmers FC.
insight.analyst_note: Saved from a short-range corner after a 7-pass build-up; keeping the clean sheet preserved Benchwarmers’ strong control of possession (63.6%) and protected their 0-2 lead, forcing Carb Loaders to take greater risks thereafter.

commentary.line: G. Ojeda pulls off a huge save to deny L. Castagne from close range after I. Cardoso’s corner delivery — Carb Loaders still chasing a lifeline at 58'.

analyst.en.title: Huge stop from Ojeda
analyst.en.body: Ojeda palms away Castagne’s close-range corner after a 7-pass build-up, keeping Benchwarmers two goals clear and their control of the game intact.
analyst.en.why: Kept Benchwarmers’ lead — the shot would have raised Carb Loaders’ win chance from 1.7% to 6.7%, a 5% swing away from Benchwarmers.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Short-range corner chance (xG 0.72) from 3.4 m at 88.4 km/h after 7 build-up passes; the save protected the clean sheet and Benchwarmers’ possession dominance (63.6%).

analyst.fr.title: Arrêt colossal d'Ojeda
analyst.fr.body: Ojeda détourne une frappe de L. Castagne après un corner; maintien du 0-2 et contrôle du match préservé par Benchwarmers FC.
analyst.fr.why: Si ce tir (xG 0,72) avait été marqué, la chance de victoire de Carb Loaders serait passée de 1,7% à 6,7% — un changement de 5 points.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Arrêt sur une tentative à courte distance après une phase à 7 passes; garder le clean sheet a protégé le contrôle de possession (63,6%) et contraint Carb Loaders à prendre plus de risques.

analyst.es.title: Parada decisiva de Ojeda
analyst.es.body: Ojeda evitó un gol tras un córner y mantuvo el 0-2; remate de Castagne a 88.4 km/h con xG 0.72 desde 3.4 m tras una jugada de 7 pases.
analyst.es.why: Si hubiera sido gol, Carb Loaders habría subido su probabilidad de ganar de 1.7% a 6.7% — cambio de +5 puntos que habría apretado el partido.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Parada a bocajarro tras una construcción de 7 pases; preservó la ventaja visitante y forzó a Carb Loaders a asumir más riesgo pese al 63.6% de posesión rival.

analyst.pt.title: Defesa gigante de Ojeda
analyst.pt.body: Ojeda nega Castagne após canto curto e mantém o 0-2 — salva a vantagem construída pelo jogo de posse dos Benchwarmers.
analyst.pt.why: Impediu o golo que aumentaria a chance de vitória do Carb Loaders de 1,7% para 6,7% — mudou 5 pontos percentuais a favor dos Benchwarmers.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Defesa a curta distância depois de 7 passes; manteve a baliza inviolada, preservando o domínio de posse (63,6%) e forçando o adversário a arriscar mais.

home-fan.en.title: What a save by Ojeda!
home-fan.en.body: G. Ojeda kept out L. Castagne’s close-range shot from a corner — a thunderbolt at 88 km/h. That stop kept Benchwarmers two goals up and frustrated Carb Loaders.
home-fan.en.why: If that had gone in, Carb Loaders’ chance to win would’ve jumped from 1.7% to 6.7% — Ojeda kept Benchwarmers comfortably ahead.

home-fan.fr.title: Arrêt énorme d'Ojeda

away-fan.es.title: ¡Parada enorme de Ojeda!

away-fan.pt.title: Defesa gigante do Ojeda

player-focus.es.title: ¡Parada enorme de Ojeda!

player-focus.es.why: Si llega a entrar, Carb Loaders habría subido su probabilidad de ganar del 1.7% al 6.7% — Ojeda quitó 5 puntos porcentuales a la posible reacción.

analyst.pt.body: Momento de alta intensidade: Carb Loaders ganham controlo e criam pressão sustentada, apesar do 0-2. Mudança clara no equilíbrio táctico do jogo.

home-fan.en.title: Carb Loaders fight back
home-fan.en.body: At 61' we’ve seized control — lots of pressure and chances despite being 0-2 down. This feels like a real comeback push.

home-fan.fr.title: Retour de tempo

home-fan.es.title: ¡Carb Loaders toma impulso!

home-fan.pt.title: Virada de momento a favor
home-fan.pt.body: Aos 61' os Carb Loaders estão a dominar agora e a criar perigo consistente — ainda estamos 0-2, mas a equipa pressiona e empurra para o empate.
home-fan.pt.why: Este impulso mostra que estamos a recuperar controlo e a aumentar a hipótese de virar o resultado, mudando o equilíbrio do jogo.

away-fan.en.title: Carb Loaders on the rise
away-fan.en.body: Carb Loaders have just seized momentum—pressing hard and looking dangerous despite being 0-2 down. Benchwarmers, stay alert: they’re pushing for a comeback.
away-fan.en.why: This swing shows Carb Loaders are winning control and creating sustained threat, increasing their chance to fight back into the game.

away-fan.fr.title: Carb Loaders repartent à l’attaque
away-fan.fr.body: Même menés 0-2, ils reprennent le contrôle et poussent fort — danger constant dans les prochaines minutes.
away-fan.fr.why: Ce tournant à 61' montre que Carb Loaders récupèrent le jeu et augmentent leurs chances de revenir au score.

away-fan.es.title: Carb Loaders se reactiva
away-fan.es.body: A los 61' Carb Loaders dominan el juego ahora: presionan más y crean peligro pese al 0-2. Se notan vivos y pueden meterse de nuevo en el partido.
away-fan.es.why: Cambia el ritmo: sube la amenaza de Carb Loaders y aumenta su opción de remontar tras recuperar control sostenido.

away-fan.pt.title: Carb Loaders ganha ímpeto
away-fan.pt.body: Aos 61' os donos do casa estão por cima agora — pressionam alto e criam perigo, mesmo estando 0-2. Atenção: podem reduzir a vantagem ainda.
away-fan.pt.why: Mudança mostra que Carb Loaders recuperou controlo e está a aumentar as chances de um regresso ao jogo.

player-focus.en.title: Cardoso’s side building up
player-focus.en.body: Carb Loaders are seizing control after a big press. Even 0-2 down, they’re creating chances and pushing Benchwarmers back — Cardoso’s shots and runs helped spark it.
player-focus.en.why: This swing shows Carb Loaders are forcing the game now, making a comeback more possible by owning chances and territory.

player-focus.fr.title: Cardoso relance le jeu
player-focus.fr.body: Carb Loaders reprennent l'initiative après une belle séquence — ils poussent fort malgré le 0-2. I. Cardoso est au cœur du mouvement.
player-focus.fr.why: Ce moment montre que l'équipe revient dans le match et crée du danger, augmentant la chance d'un retour.

player-focus.es.title: Cardoso prende el juego
player-focus.es.body: Carb Loaders recuperan ritmo y presionan: ahora dominan la acción y crean más peligro tras varios robos altos. Cardoso fue clave en las últimas jugadas.
player-focus.es.why: Este impulso sube la posibilidad de remontada: Carb Loaders toman control y empiezan a acorralar al rival tras el 0-2.

player-focus.pt.title: Cardoso voltou a mexer
player-focus.pt.body: Aos 61' a maré vira: Carb Loaders dominam mais e criam perigo contínuo, mesmo perdendo 0-2. Boa hora para o I. Cardoso aparecer.
player-focus.pt.why: Isso mostra que a equipa recupera controlo e aumenta a chance de reagir — jogo fica mais vivo para virar.

signal.headline: Carb Loaders break at speed from their own half; L. Castagne gets a shot away.

insight.why_it_matters: This rapid 62' counter produced a high-speed chance (xG 0.06) that briefly reduced Benchwarmers’ control and showed Carb Loaders can still threaten on transition despite being 0-2 down. Its importance score 0.45 marks it as a notable momentum probe.
insight.analyst_note: A two-pass build-up (build_up_passes 2, build_up_s 14) exploited space left by Benchwarmers after their sustained possession; Castagne’s sixth shot (shots 6) came from a 16 m run and tests Benchwarmers’ transitional recovery rather than sustained pressure.

commentary.line: Carb Loaders burst forward — F. Ríos slips a slick pass and L. Castagne lashes a low 16m effort, but Benchwarmers' keeper stands firm.

analyst.en.title: Fast break tests Benchwarmers
analyst.en.body: Two-pass counter sees L. Castagne sprint 16 m and shoot at 82.6 km/h top speed; a quick probe that briefly interrupted Benchwarmers’ control.
analyst.en.why: Showed Carb Loaders can still threaten on transition and briefly dented Benchwarmers’ control, a notable momentum probe despite the 0-2 deficit.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Two-pass, 14s build exploited space after Benchwarmers’ sustained possession; Castagne’s sixth shot (shots 6) from 16 m tests their transitional recovery, not sustained pressure.

analyst.fr.title: Contre rapide des Carb Loaders
analyst.fr.body: L. Castagne reçoit après 2 passes, file à 82,6 km/h et arme une frappe du pied à 16 m — chance courte mais révélatrice en transition.
analyst.fr.why: Réduit brièvement le contrôle adverse et montre que Carb Loaders peuvent encore menacer en contre, impact faible sur la victoire.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Construction en 2 passes sur 14 s; tir n°6 de Castagne depuis 16 m. Teste la récupération défensive de Benchwarmers plutôt qu’une pression prolongée.

analyst.es.title: Contraataque rápido de Carb Loaders
analyst.es.body: L. Castagne remata tras contra de 2 pases; carrera de 16 m a 82.6 km/h, oportunidad de xG 0.06 que desafía la recuperación rival.
analyst.es.why: Reducir momentáneamente el control rival; mostró que Carb Loaders aún pueden amenazar en transición pese al 0-2.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Construcción en 2 pases (14 s) aprovechó espacio dejado por Benchwarmers; sexto disparo de Castagne desde 16 m, prueba la recuperación defensiva en transición.

analyst.pt.title: Contra‑ataque veloz de Carb
analyst.pt.body: L. Castagne remata após contra rápida de 2 passes — chute de 16 m, velocidade 82,6 km/h, xG 0,06. Mostrou perigo em transição apesar do 0-2.
analyst.pt.why: Reduziu momentaneamente o controlo do Benchwarmers e foi uma sondagem de momentum importante mesmo sem alterar o resultado.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Construção em 2 passes (14s) explorou espaço deixado pelo adversário; 6.º remate de Castagne vindo de corrida de 16 m, avaliando recuperação defensiva rival.

home-fan.en.title: Fast break threatens
home-fan.en.body: Carb Loaders raced from their half; L. Castagne fired from 16 m after a quick two-pass move. Shot was fast (82.6 km/h) but low chance to score.
home-fan.en.why: It briefly dented Benchwarmers’ control and showed we can still hurt them on the break despite being 0-2 down.

home-fan.fr.title: Contre rapide prometteur
home-fan.fr.body: 62' — Carb Loaders lancent un contre fulgurant; L. Castagne tire après une passe de F. Ríos. Ça montre qu’on peut encore faire mal malgré le 0-2.
home-fan.fr.why: Ce tir rapide (chance modeste) a brièvement réduit le contrôle adverse et prouvé qu’on peut encore menacer en transition.

home-fan.es.title: Contra relámpago de Carb
home-fan.es.body: Castagne lanzó desde 16 m tras una salida rápida; el disparo llegó tras pase de F. Ríos y alcanzó 82.6 km/h en la jugada. Aún pueden crear peligro pese al 0-2.
home-fan.es.why: Mostró que, aunque vamos perdiendo 0-2, el equipo sigue encontrando espacios al contraataque y empezó a recortar el control del rival.

home-fan.pt.title: Contra-ataque rápido
home-fan.pt.body: Aos 62', Carb Loaders saem em velocidade; L. Castagne atira após passe de F. Ríos — boa oportunidade, mesmo com o 0-2.
home-fan.pt.why: Mostrou que ainda conseguimos criar perigo em transição e por um momento abateu o controlo do Benchwarmers, um pequeno sopro de esperança.

player-focus.en.title: Castagne’s fast break
player-focus.en.body: From their half, Carb Loaders sprinted forward; F. Ríos set up L. Castagne, who fired with his foot after a 16 m run. A quick chance that worried Benchwarmers.
player-focus.en.why: Shows Carb Loaders can still hurt on the break and briefly dented Benchwarmers’ control, a useful shove while chasing two goals.

player-focus.fr.title: Contre rapide des Carb Loaders
player-focus.fr.body: L. Castagne part à toute vitesse après une passe de F. Ríos et frappe du pied de loin — belle tentative malgré le 0-2.
player-focus.fr.why: Cette contre-attaque a montré que les Carb Loaders peuvent encore créer du danger en transition et a brièvement réduit le contrôle des Benchwarmers.

player-focus.es.title: ¡Contrataque veloz de Carb Loaders!
player-focus.es.body: L. Castagne recibe tras pase de F. Ríos y dispara tras una carrera rápida: peligro claro en transición, aunque no cambió el marcador.
player-focus.es.why: Mostró que, pese al 0-2, Carb Loaders puede buscar respuestas rápidas y molestó la posesión rival brevemente.

player-focus.pt.title: Contra-ataque rápido de Castagne
player-focus.pt.body: L. Castagne saiu em velocidade desde a nossa área e atirou de pé depois do passe de F. Ríos — um remate perigoso que mostrou que ainda podemos criar perigo mesmo a perder 0-2.
player-focus.pt.why: Mostrou que o time ainda pode surpreender no contra-ataque e momentaneamente reduziu o controlo dos adversários; um aviso importante mesmo sem golo.

signal.headline: Carb Loaders are dominating: 2 shots and 40% possession in the last 5 minutes.

insight.why_it_matters: Carb Loaders' brief spell of control (2 shots, 40.4% possession in the last 5 minutes) is their clearest chance to turn momentum back while trailing 0-2 at 63'. The match momentum metric (97.9) shows Benchwarmers still firmly dominant overall.
insight.analyst_note: Despite improved activity (18 passes, 2 shots) Carb Loaders still trail in overall possession and pass accuracy (36.7% and 0.679) and face a Benchwarmers side with superior control (63.3% possession, 435 passes). To convert this period into genuine threat they must increase passes per possession above the current 2.7 and force more turnovers high up the pitch.

commentary.line: Carb Loaders are piling on pressure at 63' — two shots and 40% of the last five minutes, but Benchwarmers still lead 2-0 and look comfortable.

analyst.en.title: Carb Loaders temporary control
analyst.en.body: They've had 2 shots and 40.4% possession in the last 5 minutes — a brief window to reduce the 0–2 deficit, but overall control still favors Benchwarmers FC heavily.
analyst.en.why: This spell is Carb Loaders' best chance to shift momentum while down 0–2; Benchwarmers still dominate overall, so quick high turnovers are needed to make it matter.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Carb Loaders show activity (18 passes, 2 shots) but lag in possession and pass accuracy (36.7%, 0.679). They must raise passes per possession above 2.7 and force high turnovers to create real threat.

analyst.fr.title: Carb Loaders reprennent l'initiative?
analyst.fr.body: Court temps fort : 2 tirs et 40,4% de possession sur les 5 dernières minutes. Ils cherchent à réduire le déficit alors qu'ils sont menés 0-2.
analyst.fr.why: Ce bref contrôle est la meilleure chance des Carb Loaders pour inverser la dynamique; Benchwarmers restent largement dominants (momentum 97,9).
