analyst.es.title: Carb Loaders reaccionan tarde
analyst.es.body: Breve dominio: 2 tiros y 40.4% de posesión en últimos 5 minutos. Aun así Benchwarmers mantiene control claro y partido 0-2.
analyst.es.why: Este empujón es la mejor oportunidad para recortar antes del final; el momentum (97.9) sigue favoreciendo a Benchwarmers.
analyst.es.analyst_note: A pesar de más actividad (18 pases, 2 tiros), Carb Loaders siguen por detrás en posesión y precisión (36.7% y 0.679). Necesitan subir pases por posesión >2.7 y forzar pérdidas altas.

analyst.pt.title: Carb Loaders pressionam agora
analyst.pt.body: Período curto com 2 remates e 40,4% de posse oferece a melhor oportunidade para reduzir a desvantagem. Benchwarmers ainda controlam o jogo pelo momentum.
analyst.pt.why: Esse turno de controlo é a melhor hipótese de virar o momentum enquanto perdem 0-2; Benchwarmers mantêm domínio geral.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Apesar de 18 passes e 2 remates, Carb Loaders ficam atrás em posse (36,7%) e eficácia de passe (0,679). Precisam de aumentar passes por posse e forçar perdas altas.

home-fan.en.title: Carb Loaders push back
home-fan.en.body: A short bright spell: 2 shots and about 40% possession in the last 5 minutes. Still 0-2, but this is their best chance to claw back momentum.
home-fan.en.why: This small run is Carb Loaders’ clearest chance to shift momentum while trailing 0-2 — Benchwarmers still have the overall edge.

home-fan.fr.title: Carb Loaders reprennent un peu le contrôle
home-fan.fr.body: Sur les 5 dernières minutes : 2 tirs et 40% de possession — la meilleure occasion de revenir alors qu’on perd 0-2 à la 63e.
home-fan.fr.why: C’est notre fenêtre pour inverser le momentum : si on transforme cette montée en actions dangereuses, on peut réduire l’écart.

home-fan.es.title: ¡Carb Loaders presionando ahora!
home-fan.es.body: Últimos 5': 2 disparos y 40% de posesión. Es su mejor racha para recortar el 0-2 — mantengan la presión y busquen la contra.
home-fan.es.why: Este tramo es la mejor oportunidad para volver al partido; Benchwarmers sigue dominando, pero aquí pueden generar peligro y cambiar momentum.

home-fan.pt.title: Carb Loaders a pressionar
home-fan.pt.body: Nos últimos 5 minutos tivemos 2 remates e 40% de bola — a melhor chance de virar o jogo aos 63', ainda perdemos 0-2.
home-fan.pt.why: Este período é a oportunidade mais clara para reduzir a diferença — mas o adversário continua dominante, o que torna a virada difícil.

player-focus.en.title: Cardoso’s chance to spark
player-focus.en.body: Carb Loaders just had 2 shots and 40% possession in the last 5 minutes — their best spell to claw back while down 0-2. Look for I. Cardoso to try and lead the attack.
player-focus.en.why: This short burst is the clearest chance to shift momentum and create real danger while trailing 0-2; it didn’t yet overturn Benchwarmers’ overall control.

player-focus.fr.title: Carb Loaders poussent
player-focus.fr.body: Un bon moment pour I. Cardoso: 2 tirs et 40% de possession sur les 5 dernières minutes. C’est l’occasion de réduire le score.
player-focus.fr.why: C’est leur meilleure chance de revenir avant la fin: ce bref contrôle peut relancer la dynamique alors qu’ils sont menés 0-2.

player-focus.es.title: ¡Oportunidad para Cardoso!
player-focus.es.body: Carb Loaders han tenido 2 remates y 40% de la posesión en los últimos 5 minutos. Es su mejor tramo para intentar recortar el 0-2 y empujar con Cardoso arriba.
player-focus.es.why: Este empujón es la mejor chance ahora para volver al partido; si lo aprovecháis cambia algo la dinámica aunque Benchwarmers sigue mandando.

player-focus.pt.title: Boa reação dos Carb Loaders
player-focus.pt.body: Nos últimos 5 minutos: 2 remates e 40% de bola — a melhor chance de virar o jogo antes do apito. Continua preciso e perigoso, I. Cardoso.
player-focus.pt.why: Este período é a melhor oportunidade real de reduzir o prejuízo e tentar recuperar o ritmo contra um Benchwarmers ainda dominante.

signal.headline: GOAL! L. Castagne scores for Carb Loaders. Carb Loaders 1-2 Benchwarmers FC.

insight.why_it_matters: Castagne's goal pulls Carb Loaders back into the match at 66', reducing Benchwarmers' lead and increasing Carb Loaders' win probability by 0.1 (from 0.017 without the goal to 0.117 with it).
insight.analyst_note: After a six-pass build-up, Cardoso's key pass released Castagne into a high-quality (0.91 xG) close-range chance; the goal interrupts Benchwarmers' control in a chaotic phase and gives Carb Loaders a measurable boost in win probability despite lower possession.

commentary.line: L. Castagne slots home from close range after I. Cardoso’s clever pass — Carb Loaders pull one back and the game suddenly crackles at 66'.

analyst.en.title: Castagne pulls one back
analyst.en.body: After a six-pass move, Cardoso's through ball sets Castagne free for a close-range finish (foot). Goal cuts the deficit to 1-2 and shifts momentum back to Carb Loaders.
analyst.en.why: The goal raised Carb Loaders' win chance from 1.7% to 11.7%—a 10-point boost that makes a comeback realistic despite lower possession.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Six-pass build-up; Cardoso's key pass created a 0.91-quality, 1.5m finish. Goal disrupts Benchwarmers' control in a chaotic phase and materially improves Carb Loaders' win probability.

analyst.fr.title: BUT ! L. Castagne réduit l'écart
analyst.fr.body: Après une séquence de six passes, Cardoso sert Castagne qui conclut au pied dans une action ouverte. Carb Loaders reviennent à 1-2 et reprennent espoir.
analyst.fr.why: Ce but ramène Carb Loaders dans le match et augmente leur chance de victoire de 0,017 à 0,117 — un gain de 0,10.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Séquence en six passes : passe clé de Cardoso pour une finition proche de haute valeur (xG 0,91). Le but casse la domination adverse dans une phase chaotique.

analyst.es.title: Gol de L. Castagne
analyst.es.body: Tras una cadena de seis pases, I. Cardoso asistió a Castagne para un remate de mucha calidad. Carb Loaders recortan y vuelven a meterse en el partido.
analyst.es.why: El gol reduce la ventaja rival y aumenta la probabilidad de victoria de Carb Loaders en 0.10 (de 0.017 a 0.117), cambiando la dinámica del partido.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Tras una construcción de seis pases, el pase clave de Cardoso liberó a Castagne en una ocasión de 0.91; rompe el dominio del rival en una fase caótica y aporta un impulso medible.

analyst.pt.title: Golo de L. Castagne
analyst.pt.body: Após uma construção de 6 passes, Cardoso isolou Castagne que concluiu de pé numa oportunidade de muita qualidade (xG 0,91). Carb Loaders reduzem para 1-2 e recuperam vantagem competitiva.
analyst.pt.why: Reduziu a vantagem do Benchwarmers e aumentou a probabilidade de vitória dos Carb Loaders em 0,10 (de 0,017 para 0,117).
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Construção de seis passes; passe-chave de Cardoso libertou Castagne para uma oportunidade de 0,91 xG perto da baliza, interrompendo a fase de controlo adversária numa fase caótica.

home-fan.en.title: What a goal!
home-fan.en.body: Castagne smashes one in after Cardoso's pass — Carb Loaders back in it at 1-2. Big lift for the team and crowd.
home-fan.en.why: This goal pulled us back into the game and raised our chance to win from almost none to noticeably better.

home-fan.fr.title: BUT ! Castagne réduit l'écart
home-fan.fr.body: L. Castagne marque après une belle passe d’I. Cardoso — Carb Loaders reviennent à 1-2. L’équipe respire, le match est relancé.
home-fan.fr.why: Ramène l’équipe dans le match : la chance de gagner passe de presque nulle à clairement augmentée (gain de 0.1).

home-fan.es.title: ¡Gol de L. Castagne!
home-fan.es.body: Castagne recorta la diferencia tras una buena asistencia de I. Cardoso. Ahora 1-2 y el partido vuelve a respirar para los nuestros.
home-fan.es.why: El gol acerca a Carb Loaders: sube la probabilidad de ganar de 1.7% a 11.7%, dando vida al equipo para intentar empatar.

home-fan.pt.title: GOLO! Castagne reduz
home-fan.pt.body: L. Castagne marca de pé após passe de I. Cardoso. Carb Loaders agora 1-2 — jogo de novo em disputa.
home-fan.pt.why: Traz a equipa de volta: a vitória dos Carb Loaders passa de 1,7% para 11,7% — muito mais esperança até ao fim.

away-fan.en.title: Goal for Carb Loaders
away-fan.en.body: Castagne nets from close after Cardoso’s pass. Score now 1-2 — Benchwarmers still ahead, but Carb Loaders have some life.
away-fan.en.why: This goal cut Benchwarmers' lead and raised Carb Loaders’ chance to win by about 10 percentage points, so the game feels more tense now.

away-fan.fr.title: BUT ! Castagne réduit l'écart
away-fan.fr.body: L. Castagne marque après une passe d'I. Cardoso — Carb Loaders reviennent à 1-2, l’espoir renaît.
away-fan.fr.why: Ce but remet Carb Loaders dans le match : leur chance de gagner passe de 1,7% à 11,7%, donc ça change l’atmosphère et l’espoir.

away-fan.es.title: GOAL de L. Castagne
away-fan.es.body: ¡Qué gol! Castagne remata con el pie tras el pase de Cardoso y recortamos: 1-2. Energía y esperanza para volver al partido.
away-fan.es.why: Esto mete al Carb Loaders de nuevo en la pelea: la victoria del rival baja y nuestra posibilidad de ganar sube un 10% tras el gol.

away-fan.pt.title: GOLO! Castagne reduz
away-fan.pt.body: L. Castagne marca após passe de I. Cardoso. Carb Loaders agora 1-2 Benchwarmers FC — jogo mais vivo, mas ainda estamos por cima.
away-fan.pt.why: Este golo trouxe esperança à equipa da casa e subiu a sua hipótese de ganhar de 1.7% para 11.7%, tornando o jogo mais perigoso para nós.

player-focus.en.title: What a setup by Cardoso!
player-focus.en.body: Castagne buries Cardoso’s pass to make it 1-2 — a real lifeline for the Carb Loaders. Simple, quick move finished from close range with power.
player-focus.en.why: This goal pulls your team back into the game and raises their chance to win from almost zero to noticeably better.

player-focus.fr.title: But! Cardoso offre un but
player-focus.fr.body: Quelle passe d’I. Cardoso — Castagne conclut et réduit le score à 1-2. Un vrai moment pour relancer le match et motiver l’équipe.
player-focus.fr.why: Cela ramène Carb Loaders dans le match et augmente leur chance de gagner de 1% à 12% — ça change l’ambiance et l’espoir.

player-focus.es.title: ¡Gol de Castagne!
player-focus.es.body: Gran pase de I. Cardoso y Castagne marca con la zurda para poner el 1-2. Energía y esperanza para los nuestros.
player-focus.es.why: Este gol acerca al Carb Loaders: sube la probabilidad de ganar del 1.7% al 11.7%, devolviendo vida al partido.

player-focus.pt.title: Que gol! Castagne marca
player-focus.pt.body: Cardoso dá a assistência: passe de 6 toques e Castagne finaliza com o pé para reduzir para 1-2. Energia voltou ao time.
player-focus.pt.why: Recoloca a Carb Loaders na disputa: a chance de vitória sobe de 1,7% para 11,7% graças a este golo.

signal.headline: Carb Loaders take control: 66% possession and 4.3 passes per possession over the last 5 minutes.

insight.why_it_matters: Carb Loaders’ sustained control (66% possession, 4.3 passes/possession) at 69' shows they’ve settled the game’s rhythm and are forcing Benchwarmers FC to defend, giving them the best route back into a 1-2 scoreline late in the match.
insight.analyst_note: Despite trailing, Carb Loaders have reduced chaos (chaos_index 27.4) and lowered turnovers (1.2/min) by keeping the ball in structured sequences rather than direct play; this increases opportunities to create higher-quality chances while tiring Benchwarmers’ defensive shape.

commentary.line: Carb Loaders finally taking control—66% possession, tidy 4.3 passes per spell—piling pressure after that 62' break, hunting a route back into this game.

analyst.en.title: Carb Loaders seize rhythm
analyst.en.body: Carb Loaders control the ball — 66% possession and 4.3 passes per possession. They’ve slowed the game, reduced chaotic turnovers and are probing Benchwarmers’ defence for a route back into the match.
analyst.en.why: Their sustained control settles game rhythm, lowers turnovers and creates better chances — the clearest path for a late comeback from 1-2 down.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Chaos index 27.4 and turnovers 1.2/min show structured sequences over direct play; sustained possession pressures Benchwarmers’ defensive block and increases chance quality.

analyst.fr.title: Carb Loaders reprennent le rythme
analyst.fr.body: Contrôle prolongé : 66% de possession et 4,3 passes par possession. Moins de jeu direct (13,3% de longues passes) — ils posent le jeu pour revenir au score.
analyst.fr.why: Ce contrôle stabilise le tempo et fatigue la défense adverse, offrant la meilleure voie pour réduire l'écart et forcer Benchwarmers FC à reculer.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Réduction du chaos (chaos_index 27,4) et turnovers limités (1,2/min) via séquences structurées plutôt que jeu direct, augmentant les chances de créer opportunités de qualité.

analyst.es.title: Carb Loaders control el ritmo
analyst.es.body: 66% de posesión y 4.3 pases por posesión en los últimos 5 minutos: están tocando con paciencia y obligan a Benchwarmers a replegarse, buscando el camino para el 1-2.
analyst.es.why: Este control baja el caos y crea más opciones para generar oportunidades de gol y desgastar la defensa rival, la mejor vía para empatar tarde en el partido.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Caos reducido (27.4) y menos pérdidas (1.2/min). Jugar en secuencias estructuradas en lugar de balones largos (13.3%) aumenta probabilidad de generar ocasiones de mayor calidad.

analyst.pt.title: Carb Loaders assumem o ritmo
analyst.pt.body: A equipa controla o jogo: 66% de posse e 4,3 passes por posse. Reduziram o caos e conectam jogadas para forçar Benchwarmers a defender mais atrás.
analyst.pt.why: Esta posse sustentada estabiliza o ritmo e dá a melhor via para reduzir para 1-2 nos minutos finais — pressiona a defesa dos visitantes e cria oportunidades de golo.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Com chaos_index 27.4 e 1.2 turnovers/min, optaram por sequências estruturadas em vez de jogo direto, elevando a qualidade das oportunidades e desgastando a linha defensiva adversária.

signal.headline: Carb Loaders break at speed from their own half; I. Cardoso gets a shot away.

insight.why_it_matters: This fast break (xG 0.08) is a high-leverage moment—Carb Loaders (trailing 1-2) created their clearest transition chance late in the game, briefly disrupting Benchwarmers' control and offering a route back into the match.
insight.analyst_note: The move came from a short two-pass outlet (build_up_passes 2) with L. Castagne as the key passer; Cardoso’s run and top speed (103.1 km/h measured on the sequence) produced a quick 10.7m opportunity that increased immediate attacking pressure despite Benchwarmers’ overall possession control.

commentary.line: Cardoso races clear on 70', Castagne's threaded pass — a low, driven finish from I. Cardoso forces Benchwarmers' keeper into another big stop.

analyst.en.title: Fast break creates big chance
analyst.en.body: Carb Loaders countered with two quick passes; L. Castagne fed I. Cardoso whose run produced a 10.7m shot (measured top burst 103.1 km/h) — a clear route back into the game.
analyst.en.why: This high-leverage transition (xG 0.08) was Carb Loaders’ best late chance, briefly disrupting Benchwarmers’ control and raising immediate winning chances.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Short two-pass outlet (build_up_passes 2). Castagne the key passer; Cardoso’s run and top burst (103.1 km/h) created a 10.7m opportunity, increasing transition pressure despite low possession.

analyst.fr.title: Contre-attaque rapide
analyst.fr.body: Carb Loaders ont filé en transition; I. Cardoso a tiré du pied après une passe clé de L. Castagne — chance claire en contre, pression immédiate sur Benchwarmers.
analyst.fr.why: Cette action (xG 0,08) a créé la meilleure occasion de transition pour revenir dans le match, perturbant brièvement le contrôle adverse.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Sortie en deux passes (build_up_passes 2) via L. Castagne. Course de Cardoso à 103,1 km/h, tir depuis 10,7 m : forte pression instantanée malgré la domination de possession adversaire.

analyst.es.title: Contraataque veloz de Carb Loaders
analyst.es.body: I. Cardoso remata tras una apertura rápida de L. Castagne; tiro de 10.7 m que creó la ocasión más clara en la transición.
analyst.es.why: Redujo la presión rival momentáneamente y ofreció la ruta más directa para intentar empatar, aumentando la amenaza inmediata del equipo.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Salida en dos pases (build_up_passes 2). Castagne asistió; corrida de Cardoso alcanzó 103.1 km/h y generó un tiro con xG 0.08 a 10.7 m, incrementando la presión ofensiva pese a la posesión rival.

analyst.pt.title: Contra-ataque rápido dos Carb Loaders
analyst.pt.body: I. Cardoso recebe de L. Castagne, corre ao máximo e remata de pé numa chance clara de transição — pressionou imediatamente o adversário controlante.
analyst.pt.why: Esta transição (xG 0,08) foi a melhor oportunidade dos Carb Loaders para voltar ao jogo, perturbando momentaneamente o domínio dos Benchwarmers.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Saída em duas passes (build_up_passes 2) com passe-chave de L. Castagne; corrida de Cardoso e pico de 103,1 km/h geraram um remate a 10,7 m que aumentou pressão ofensiva imediata.

home-fan.en.title: Quick break sparks hope
home-fan.en.body: Cardoso races from his half, Castagne feeds him and he fires from 10.7m. Big sprint, decent chance that jolted the game.
home-fan.en.why: This fast counter was Carb Loaders’ clearest route back—briefly shook Benchwarmers’ control and gave us a real chance to level the score.

home-fan.fr.title: Contre rapide des Carb
home-fan.fr.body: Cardoso reçoit, part vite et tire — la meilleure occasion des nôtres en transition. On sentait qu’on pouvait revenir.
home-fan.fr.why: Cette contre-attaque a créé la meilleure chance (xG 0,08) pour revenir au score et a troublé le contrôle adverse.

home-fan.es.title: ¡Contra relámpago de Carb Loaders!
home-fan.es.body: I. Cardoso dispara tras una rápida salida: pase clave de L. Castagne y carrera hasta un tiro potente desde 10.7 m.
home-fan.es.why: Importante: fue la mejor opción en la contra, dio esperanza al 1-2 y rompió el dominio rival por un momento.

home-fan.pt.title: Contra-ataque rápido
home-fan.pt.body: Cardoso recebeu de Castagne, acelerou e rematou — chance clara vinda de um contra-ataque que nos deu esperança para empatar.
home-fan.pt.why: Importa porque foi a melhor chance numa transição rápida (xG 0,08) — mostrou que ainda podíamos voltar ao jogo e perturbar o controlo adversário.

player-focus.en.title: Cardoso’s quick break
player-focus.en.body: I. Cardoso races clear after a two-pass break. He fires a foot shot from about 10.7 m — a big chance to get us back in the game.
player-focus.en.why: This quick counter was our best route back—had highest chance to change the score and briefly unsettled Benchwarmers’ control.

player-focus.fr.title: Contre rapide de Cardoso
player-focus.fr.body: I. Cardoso part vite après une passe de L. Castagne, frappe du pied à pleine vitesse — la meilleure occasion de transition pour Carb Loaders ce soir.
player-focus.fr.why: Cette contre-attaque (chance 0,08) a été la meilleure occasion tardive pour revenir au score et a bousculé le contrôle de Benchwarmers.

player-focus.es.title: ¡Contra rápida de Cardoso!
player-focus.es.body: I. Cardoso remata tras un contraataque veloz iniciado por L. Castagne; fue la mejor opción de los Carb Loaders para meterse en el partido.
player-focus.es.why: Importa porque, yendo 1-2, esta contra (probabilidad 0.08) fue la ocasión más clara al final y rompió el control del rival.

player-focus.pt.title: Cardoso arrisca no contra-ataque
player-focus.pt.body: I. Cardoso parte rápido de metade do campo, recebe de L. Castagne e remata com o pé — a melhor chance de contra dos Carb Loaders hoje.
player-focus.pt.why: Momento de alta pressão: ofereceu a chance mais clara em transição e deu esperança de empatar apesar do domínio do Benchwarmers.

signal.headline: Carb Loaders' press pays off: ball won high up and a shot within 14 seconds.

insight.why_it_matters: Winning the ball high led directly to a quality chance (xG 0.34) within 14 seconds, showing Carb Loaders can turn pressure into immediate shots despite trailing 1-2 late in the second half.
insight.analyst_note: A successful high turnover from sustained pressing (Carb Loaders: 65 pressures, 8 high_turnovers) produced a quick 4-pass sequence and a shot by J. Albrecht; this underlines an effective transitional route to goal when they win possession in advanced areas.

commentary.line: Brilliant high press from Carb Loaders — I. Cardoso wins it, J. Albrecht volleys on the turn inside 14 seconds, stinging chance!

analyst.en.title: High press creates quick chance
analyst.en.body: Carb Loaders forced a turnover high, moved the ball in 4 passes and J. Albrecht fired a 0.34-quality shot after 14 seconds — clear proof pressure can make instant chances.
analyst.en.why: Turnover high up led to a quality chance (xG 0.34) inside 14s, showing pressing converts into immediate opportunities despite trailing 1-2.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Sustained pressing (65 pressures, 8 high turnovers) triggered a 4-pass transition; Albrecht’s shot (xG 0.34) exemplifies an effective route to goal from advanced turnovers.

analyst.fr.title: Press haut payant
analyst.fr.body: Pressing intense: récupération haute, 4 passes et tir de J. Albrecht en 14 s (xG 0,34). Preuve que la pression crée des occasions rapides malgré le score.
analyst.fr.why: La récupération haute a abouti à une grosse occasion (xG 0,34) en 14 s — montre un vrai moyen de revenir au score tardif.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Pressing soutenu (65 pressions, 8 récupérations hautes) -> séquence en 4 passes et tir d’Albrecht : transition efficace vers le but depuis zones avancées.

analyst.es.title: Recuperación alta y disparo
analyst.es.body: Presión sostenida + recuperación alta -> 4 pases y disparo de J. Albrecht con xG 0,34 en 14 s; mostró cómo generar oportunidades rápidas pese al 1-2.
analyst.es.why: La recuperación alta creó una ocasión clara (xG 0,34) en 14 s, demostrando que la presión puede traducirse en disparos inmediatos cuando falta el empate.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Presión efectiva: 65 presiones y 8 recuperaciones altas. Secuencia de 4 pases en transición terminó en el disparo de Albrecht, válida rutas rápidas hacia la portería.

analyst.pt.title: Pressão alta gera remate
analyst.pt.body: Pressão dos Carb Loaders culmina numa recuperação alta e num remate de J. Albrecht após sequência de 4 passes em 14s — oportunidade de qualidade (xG 0,34).
analyst.pt.why: Mostra que pressionar alto cria chances imediatas: recuperação rápida levou a um remate valioso que podia reduzir a desvantagem tardia.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Recuperação alta bem-sucedida de uma pressão prolongada (65 pressures, 8 high_turnovers) gerou sequência de 4 passes e o remate de Albrecht, evidenciando transição eficaz em zonas avançadas.

home-fan.en.title: Press wins a quick shot
home-fan.en.body: Carb Loaders win the ball high, four quick passes and J. Albrecht fires—good chance inside 14 seconds. Feels like pressure is paying off even while we’re 1-2 down.
home-fan.en.why: This showed our press can make instant chances: a real shot (xG 0.34) within 14s, keeping us fighting late on.

home-fan.fr.title: Press payant, tir rapide
home-fan.fr.body: Carb Loaders ont récupéré haut, enchaîné 4 passes et J. Albrecht a tiré 14s plus tard — grosse occasion malgré le 1-2.
home-fan.fr.why: Montre qu’en pressant haut ils créent vite des occasions : tir de qualité en 14s, utile pour revenir au score.

home-fan.es.title: Presión que casi paga
home-fan.es.body: Recuperan arriba y, en 14 s, J. Albrecht dispara (xG 0.34). Demuestra que la presión puede crear ocasiones aunque vayamos 1-2.
home-fan.es.why: Importante: la recuperación alta generó una ocasión de calidad enseguida; demuestra que presionando podemos volver al partido.

home-fan.pt.title: Pressão dá chance rápida
home-fan.pt.body: Carb Loaders roubaram alto e, em 14s e 4 passes, J. Albrecht atirou (xG 0,34). Boa resposta apesar do 1-2.
home-fan.pt.why: Mostra que a pressão rende chances imediatas — podia ter mudado o jogo perto do fim.

player-focus.en.title: Cardoso wins it high
player-focus.en.body: I. Cardoso forces a turnover high up; 14 seconds later J. Albrecht fires a strong shot (good chance). Quick pressure nearly paid off while we're chasing the game.
player-focus.en.why: Shows Cardoso can spark instant danger from pressing — turned a win into a big chance quickly when we needed it.

player-focus.fr.title: Pressing payant !
player-focus.fr.body: I. Cardoso récupère haut et lance l’action : 4 passes, 14 s, puis J. Albrecht tire. On s’approche d’un but malgré le 1-2.
player-focus.fr.why: Cette récupération haute a donné une occasion claire (xG 0,34) en 14 secondes — preuve que ton joueur crée du danger immédiatement.

player-focus.es.title: Recuperación alta y tiro
player-focus.es.body: I. Cardoso roba alto y, en 14 s, J. Albrecht dispara (xG 0.34). Gran presión que crea oportunidad cuando más lo necesitamos para empatar.
player-focus.es.why: Muestra que la presión de Cardoso puede crear tiros rápidos (xG 0.34) pese a ir 1-2; vuelve a ponernos cerca del empate.

player-focus.pt.title: Pressão dá chance rápida
player-focus.pt.body: I. Cardoso ganhou a bola alto e, em 14s, J. Albrecht rematou (xG 0,34). Mostra que pressionar pode virar oportunidade, mesmo perdendo 1-2.
player-focus.pt.why: Mostra que o teu jogador, I. Cardoso, pode transformar pressão em chance imediata — reduz a diferença num instante.

signal.headline: Big chance! J. Albrecht fires wide from 6 m (xG 0.34).

insight.why_it_matters: This miss kept Carb Loaders trailing late — the shot had an xG of 0.34 and, per impact modelling, cost them 0.234 in win probability (their chance would have risen to 24.2% if scored).
insight.analyst_note: The chance came from short, fast build-up (4 passes, 14s) with a pressing win to create the 6m finish; converting would have materially changed late-game tactics by forcing Benchwarmers FC away from conservative game management and increasing Carb Loaders' incentive to press higher.

commentary.line: Albrecht smashes a close-range effort wide after Cardoso's clever feed — another gilt-edged chance gone for Carb Loaders as the pressure mounts (73').

analyst.en.title: Huge chance missed by Albrecht
analyst.en.body: J. Albrecht volleys wide from 6 m after a quick 4-pass move. Shot speed 84 km/h; quality 0.34. A goal would’ve lifted Carb Loaders’ win chance to 24.2%.
analyst.en.why: Kept Carb Loaders trailing late — scoring would’ve increased their win chance by 23.4 percentage points, changing late tactics and pressure on Benchwarmers FC.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Short, rapid build-up (4 passes, 14s) plus a pressing win created the near-post 6 m finish; a conversion would force Benchwarmers into less conservative game management and invite higher pressing.

analyst.fr.title: Occasion énorme manquée
analyst.fr.body: J. Albrecht rate à 6 m après une courte action rapide — une frappe du pied à 84 km/h qui aurait relancé Carb Loaders dans le match.
analyst.fr.why: Si marqué, la probabilité de victoire des Carb Loaders serait passée de 0,8% à 24,2% — un vrai tournant tardif.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Action issue d’une construction courte et rapide (4 passes, 14 s) suite à un regain de pressing ; un but aurait forcé Benchwarmers FC à lâcher la gestion conservatrice du score.

analyst.es.title: Gran ocasión fallada
analyst.es.body: J. Albrecht remata con el pie desde 6 m tras 4 pases rápidos; fue desviado por la derecha del arco, xG 0.34.
analyst.es.why: Si hubiera marcado, la victoria de Carb Loaders habría subido del 0.8% al 24.2% — un cambio grande en la dinámica del final.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Construcción corta y rápida (4 pases, 14 s) tras recuperar la presión; anotar habría forzado a Benchwarmers FC a abandonar la gestión conservadora y permitido a Carb Loaders presionar más arriba.

analyst.pt.title: Grande oportunidade perdida
analyst.pt.body: J. Albrecht remata com o pé a 5,9 m, 0,34 de xG — atirou ao lado e manteve a Carb Loaders a perder por 1-2.
analyst.pt.why: Se tivesse marcado, a probabilidade de vitória da Carb Loaders subia para 24,2% — uma diferença de 23,4 pontos que teria mudado decisões táticas finais.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: A ação veio de construção curta e rápida (4 passes, 14s) após recuperar a bola; o golo teria forçado Benchwarmers FC a abandonar gestão conservadora e exposto mais espaço para pressão alta.

home-fan.en.title: Huge miss from Albrecht
home-fan.en.body: J. Albrecht blasted wide from 6 m after I. Cardoso’s pass — a very good chance that would’ve tied things up.
home-fan.en.why: Kept Carb Loaders behind late — scoring would’ve lifted their win chance from about 0.8% to 24.2%, a big change.

home-fan.fr.title: Occasion manquée !
home-fan.fr.body: J. Albrecht rate de près (pied) à 6 m après une passe d’I. Cardoso — énorme chance pour revenir au score.
home-fan.fr.why: Cette frappe ratée a empêché Carb Loaders de revenir — leur probabilité de gagner aurait grimpé à 24 % si c’était rentré.

home-fan.es.title: ¡Gran ocasión fallada!
home-fan.es.body: J. Albrecht disparó con el pie desde 6 m y la mandó fuera. I. Cardoso puso el pase; si entra, Carb Loaders subía sus opciones al 24%.
home-fan.es.why: Este fallo dejó al equipo por detrás en el tramo final; marcar habría aumentado su probabilidad de ganar de 0.8% a 24.2%, cambiando la dinámica.

home-fan.pt.title: Que grande oportunidade!
home-fan.pt.body: J. Albrecht atira ao lado de 6 m depois de passe de I. Cardoso — falha que podia ter deixado o Carb Loaders com muito mais hipóteses de empatar.
home-fan.pt.why: Este falhanço manteve-nos a perder; se tivesse entrado, a nossa hipótese de ganhar subia para 24% — mudou muito o jogo.

away-fan.en.title: Huge chance missed!
away-fan.en.body: J. Albrecht blasted wide from 6 m after I. Cardoso set him up — a big chance that would’ve turned the game around if scored.
away-fan.en.why: Miss keeps Carb Loaders behind; scoring here would’ve lifted their win chance to 24% (0.242), a 23.4 point swing.

away-fan.fr.title: Grosse occasion ratée
away-fan.fr.body: J. Albrecht tire à côté à 6 m après une passe d’I. Cardoso — une vraie chance qui aurait relancé le match pour Carb Loaders.
away-fan.fr.why: Si c’était rentré, Carb Loaders serait passé à ~24% de gain — là, ils restent derrière et le match reste sous contrôle pour Benchwarmers.

away-fan.es.title: ¡Ocasión clarísima fallada!
away-fan.es.body: J. Albrecht remata fuera desde 6 m tras pase de I. Cardoso. Era una gran oportunidad para empatar; se fue por poco.
away-fan.es.why: Esto dejó a Benchwarmers FC aún por delante; si hubiera entrado, Carb Loaders habría subido su opción de ganar del 0.8% al 24.2%.

away-fan.pt.title: Grande oportunidade desperdiçada
away-fan.pt.body: J. Albrecht atira por cima a 6 m após passe de I. Cardoso — uma chance clara que podia ter mudado o jogo.
away-fan.pt.why: Se tivesse marcado, a vitória dos Carb Loaders subia para 24% — este falhanço manteve os Benchwarmers FC na frente.

player-focus.en.title: Almost! Albrecht skies it
player-focus.en.body: I. Cardoso set him up and J. Albrecht missed from 6 m. Big chance gone — would’ve tied it late. Match stays 1-2.
player-focus.en.why: Kept Carb Loaders behind — scoring would’ve lifted win chance from 0.8% to 24.2%, a huge swing.

player-focus.fr.title: Occasion énorme manquée
player-focus.fr.body: J. Albrecht rate à 6 m après la passe de I. Cardoso — énorme opportunité pour revenir au score. Dommage, ça aurait tout changé.
player-focus.fr.why: Ce tir manqué a gardé Carb Loaders derrière. S’il avait été marqué, leur chance de gagner serait passée à 24,2 % (gain +23,4 points).

player-focus.es.title: ¡Ocasión clarísima fallada!
player-focus.es.body: J. Albrecht remata fuera desde 6 m tras pase de I. Cardoso. Era una gran opción que podía haber cambiado el partido a nuestro favor.
player-focus.es.why: Si hubiera entrado, la probabilidad de ganar de Carb Loaders habría subido del 0.8% al 24.2% — un gran giro en el tramo final.

player-focus.pt.title: Grande oportunidade perdida
player-focus.pt.body: J. Albrecht falha de 6 m após passe de I. Cardoso — chance clara que podia ter mudado o jogo. Ficámos na desvantagem.
player-focus.pt.why: Se tivesse marcado, a nossa chance de vencer subia para 24% — este remate manteve-nos a perder perto do fim.

signal.headline: Benchwarmers FC's press pays off: ball won high up and a shot within 3 seconds.

insight.why_it_matters: Winning the ball high at 74' directly produced a shot (xG 0.23) within 3 seconds, halting Carb Loaders' momentum swing and reinforcing Benchwarmers FC's control late in the match.
insight.analyst_note: The press win came after just 1 build-up pass and 3 seconds of progression, showing an aggressive front-line trigger; Benchwarmers' higher pressures (73) and lower PPDA (5.3) are translating into high turnovers (12) in advanced positions, producing high-quality, quick chances.

commentary.line: Instant reward for Benchwarmers' press — D. Assunção wins it high, P. Lozano lashes a near-post strike in three seconds, keeping their two-goal lead very much alive!

analyst.en.title: High press leads quick chance
analyst.en.body: Benchwarmers won the ball high and created a shot within 3 seconds (0.23 xG). Press numbers show intent: quick turnovers yielding quality chances late in the game.
analyst.en.why: This stopped Carb Loaders’ momentum and reinforced Benchwarmers’ control, turning pressure into a near-immediate scoring opportunity that protected the lead.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Press win after 1 build-up pass and 3 seconds of progression. Benchwarmers: 73 pressures, PPDA 5.3, 12 high turnovers — aggressive front trigger creating quick, high-quality chances.

analyst.fr.title: Pressing payant haute zone
analyst.fr.body: Récupération haute à la 74' : Lozano frappe 3s plus tard (xG 0,23). Pressing intense qui coupe l'élan adverse et crée une occasion immédiate.
analyst.fr.why: Ce regain arrête l'élan de Carb Loaders et confirme le contrôle de Benchwarmers FC en fin de match.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Victoire de pressing après 1 passe de construction et 3s de progression. Pressures 73 et PPDA 5,3 → 12 pertes hautes, générant des occasions rapides et de qualité.

analyst.es.title: Recuperación alta y tiro rápido
analyst.es.body: Press de Benchwarmers fuerza pérdida; P. Lozano dispara en 3s tras pase de D. Assunção (buenas opciones desde posición avanzada).
analyst.es.why: El robo a los 74' generó un remate (xG 0,23) en 3 segundos, frenando el impulso de Carb Loaders y consolidando el control de Benchwarmers.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Victoria de presión tras 1 pase de construcción y 3s de progresión; 73 presiones y PPDA 5,3 están convirtiendo en 12 recuperaciones altas y ocasiones rápidas.

analyst.pt.title: Pressão alta gera remate rápido
analyst.pt.body: Benchwarmers ganha a bola no terço adversário e P. Lozano remata 3s depois — xG 0,23. Mostra controlo e sufoca a reação dos Carb Loaders.
analyst.pt.why: Interrompeu a curva de momentum dos Carb Loaders e consolidou o controlo dos Benchwarmers, criando uma oportunidade de elevada qualidade imediato.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Ganho de pressão após 1 passe de construção e 3s de progressão; pressões 73 e PPDA 5,3 geram 12 turnovers avançados e oportunidades rápidas de perigo.

away-fan.en.title: Press win sparks shot
away-fan.en.body: Benchwarmers press forced a turnover and P. Lozano had a shot within 3 seconds. Quick, hungry play that kept us in control and stopped Carb Loaders' momentum.
away-fan.en.why: This high press immediately led to a 0.23 chance and stopped Carb Loaders’ momentum, helping Benchwarmers keep control late in the game.

away-fan.fr.title: Press payant en attaque
away-fan.fr.body: À la 74', Benchwarmers gagne haut, D. Assunção sert P. Lozano et tir dans les 3 secondes — grosse opportunité rapide qui coupe l'élan de Carb Loaders.
away-fan.fr.why: Ça arrête la remontée de Carb Loaders et renforce notre contrôle tard dans le match.

away-fan.es.title: Press arriba, tiro inmediato
away-fan.es.body: A los 74' Benchwarmers recupera en campo rival y P. Lozano dispara en 3 segundos (xG 0.23). Gran momento para mantener el control y cortar la reacción rival.
away-fan.es.why: Ese robo paró el empuje de Carb Loaders y reforzó el control de Benchwarmers justo cuando más importaba.

away-fan.pt.title: Press alto rende chance rápida
away-fan.pt.body: Benchwarmers ganhou a bola perto da área, P. Lozano rematou em 3 segundos — ótima pressão que manteve o controlo e criou perigo imediato.
away-fan.pt.why: Parou o impulso do adversário e reforçou o controlo do jogo, com uma chance clara feita em segundos (xG 0,23).

signal.headline: GOAL! O. Faye scores for Benchwarmers FC. Carb Loaders 1-3 Benchwarmers FC.

insight.why_it_matters: This goal at 80' pushed Benchwarmers' win probability from 85% to 99.2%, effectively sealing the result and removing Carb Loaders' late comeback hope.
insight.analyst_note: A short two-pass build-up finished by O. Faye (pressing win true) converted a high-quality chance (xG 0.78), reflecting Benchwarmers' controlled possession phase: they stretched the game and produced a clinical finish that shifted win expectancy by 0.142 in their favour.

commentary.line: Faye tucks it away from close range after Camara's threaded pass — Benchwarmers double their cushion, and Carb Loaders' comeback hopes look to be fading fast.

analyst.en.title: Faye seals it
analyst.en.body: O. Faye finishes a two-pass move from L. Camara with his foot into the net — a high-quality chance (xG 0.78) that makes the lead comfortable.
analyst.en.why: Raised Benchwarmers' win chance from 85% to 99.2%, effectively ending Carb Loaders' comeback hopes.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Two-pass build-up (pressing win) ended by Faye; xG 0.78 and a 0.142 win-probability swing show controlled possession turned into a clinical finish.

analyst.fr.title: But — O. Faye scelle le match
analyst.fr.body: Deux passes dans la construction et Faye conclut du pied (xG 0,78). Benchwarmers étendent l’avance et contrôlent la fin de match.
analyst.fr.why: Ce but fait passer la probabilité de victoire de 85% à 99,2%, éliminant toute chance de retour pour Carb Loaders.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Construction courte (2 passes), récupération de pressing puis finition clinique (xG 0,78). Gain d’espérance de victoire de +0,142, signe d’un contrôle efficace du tempo.

analyst.es.title: GOL: O. Faye amplía ventaja
analyst.es.body: Faye culmina una salida de dos pases tras recuperar la posesión y marca con el pie. Benchwarmers pasa a dominar 1-3 y prácticamente asegura la victoria.
analyst.es.why: El gol elevó la probabilidad de triunfo del 85% al 99.2%, cerrando la remontada posible del rival.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Construcción de dos pases y recuperación previa; Faye convierte una ocasión de alta calidad (xG 0.78). Resultado: control posicional y +0.142 en probabilidad de victoria.

analyst.pt.title: Golo de O. Faye

player-focus.en.title: Goal! Cardoso pulls one back
player-focus.en.body: I. Cardoso heads a finish from the short corner play — Carb Loaders now 2-3, hope back with seven minutes plus stoppage to go.
player-focus.en.why: This goal cuts the lead to one and forces Benchwarmers to stop playing safe — game is alive again.

player-focus.fr.title: But ! I. Cardoso réduit l'écart
player-focus.fr.body: Cardoso marque sur corner après une courte combinaison — Carb Loaders reviennent à 2-3, l’espoir est relancé pour la fin du match.
player-focus.fr.why: Ce but ramène l’équipe à une seule unité à sept minutes de la fin, obligeant Benchwarmers à reprendre le contrôle au lieu de gérer un avantage de deux buts.

player-focus.es.title: ¡Gol de Cardoso!
player-focus.es.body: I. Cardoso recorta a 2-3 tras un córner bien rematado. J. Albrecht le dio la asistencia; ahora Carb Loaders creen de nuevo en la remontada.
player-focus.es.why: Reduce la distancia a un gol con poco tiempo; obliga a Benchwarmers a volver a apretar y deja esperanza para Carb Loaders.

player-focus.pt.title: Golo de I. Cardoso!
player-focus.pt.body: Cardoso reduziu para 2-3 num canto bem finalizado — Albrecht assistiu. Ainda há tempo para sonhar, força!
player-focus.pt.why: Este golo traz esperança aos Carb Loaders e obriga os Benchwarmers a voltarem a controlar o jogo em vez de gerir dois golos de vantagem.

signal.headline: Carb Loaders are dominating: 1 shot and 38% possession in the last 5 minutes.

insight.why_it_matters: With 88 minutes played and Carb Loaders trailing 2-3, their late spell (1 shot, 38.3% possession in last 5 minutes) shows pressure but insufficient control to alter a match where win probability is already fully with Benchwarmers FC.
insight.analyst_note: Carb Loaders are forcing play late but their low recent possession and single shot indicate limited territorial control; Benchwarmers’ higher overall pass volume (563) and lower ppda (5.3) suggest their press and possession structure have denied sustained Carb Loader pressure.

commentary.line: Carb Loaders piling forward late but only one shot and 38% possession in five—Benchwarmers still in calm control at 2-3, soaking up pressure.

analyst.en.title: Late pressure, little control
analyst.en.body: Carb Loaders press late but only 38.3% possession and 1 shot in the last 5 minutes — not enough to overturn a 2-3 deficit against a dominant Benchwarmers structure.
analyst.en.why: Shows Carb Loaders creating pressure but lacking sustained control; win probability already fully with Benchwarmers, so this spell didn’t change the likely outcome.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Low recent possession and a single shot show limited territorial control; Benchwarmers’ 563 passes and lower pressing distance (ppda 5.3) have denied sustained Carb Loaders pressure.

analyst.fr.title: Temps fort tardif insuffisant
analyst.fr.body: À la 88e, Carb Loaders poussent (1 tir, 38,3% de possession sur les 5 dernières minutes) mais ne contrôlent pas assez le jeu pour renverser le score.
analyst.fr.why: Montre une poussée tardive mais sans domination territoriale suffisante — la probabilité de victoire reste chez Benchwarmers FC.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Faible possession récente et un seul tir montrent un contrôle territorial limité ; Benchwarmers, avec 563 passes et ppda 5,3, ont neutralisé la pression prolongée.

analyst.es.title: Carb Loaders dominan poco tarde
analyst.es.body: Con 88', Carb Loaders empujan pero sólo 38% de posesión y 1 disparo en los últimos 5'. No cambia una victoria que ya favorece totalmente a Benchwarmers FC.
analyst.es.why: Muestra presión tardía pero sin control suficiente; no alteró la probabilidad de victoria, que ya está totalmente a favor del rival.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Baja posesión reciente y un solo disparo muestran control territorial limitado. Benchwarmers: volumen de pases mayor (563) y ppda 5.3; su estructura de presión negó continuidad al ataque rival.

analyst.pt.title: Pressão tardia dos Carb Loaders
analyst.pt.body: Aos 88', Carb Loaders somaram 38,3% de posse e 1 remate nos últimos 5 minutos — pressão, mas sem controlo para virar o 2-3.
analyst.pt.why: Mostra tentativa de reação nos minutos finais, mas a posse curta e apenas um remate não alteraram a vantagem do adversário.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Baixa posse recente e só um remate mostram controlo territorial limitado; Benchwarmers, com 563 passes e ppda 5,3, negaram pressão sustentada.

home-fan.en.title: Late push but not enough
home-fan.en.body: Carb Loaders have pressed late—one shot and 38% possession in the last five minutes, but still 2-3 down. They’re trying, yet Benchwarmers hold firm.
home-fan.en.why: Shows late pressure but it didn’t shift the game; the win is still with Benchwarmers.

home-fan.fr.title: On pousse sans suffire
home-fan.fr.body: 88e — Carb Loaders poussent: 1 tir et 38% de possession ces 5 dernières minutes, mais toujours menés 2-3. Ça reste trop peu pour revenir.
home-fan.fr.why: Montée de pression tardive mais pas assez de contrôle: le match reste perdu, leur chance de victoire est nulle maintenant.

home-fan.es.title: Empuje tardío sin control
home-fan.es.body: 88' — Carb Loaders apuran: 1 tiro y 38% de posesión en los últimos 5 minutos, pero siguen perdiendo 2-3. Mucho empuje, poca claridad.
home-fan.es.why: Muestra que intentaron presionar al final, pero no lograron recuperar suficiente control para cambiar el resultado.

home-fan.pt.title: Último esforço dos Carb Loaders
home-fan.pt.body: Nos últimos 5 minutos tivemos 1 remate e 38% de bola — pressão, mas pouco controlo para virar o 2-3.
home-fan.pt.why: Mostra que estamos a tentar até ao fim, mas o jogo já está a pender totalmente para o adversário; não mudou a probabilidade de vitória.

player-focus.en.title: Cardoso's late push
player-focus.en.body: Carb Loaders are piling on pressure but only had 38% of the ball and one shot in the last 5 minutes — not enough to pull level at 2-3.
player-focus.en.why: This shows I. Cardoso helped spark a late push, but the team didn’t control enough of the game to change the result.

player-focus.fr.title: Cardoso pousse tard
player-focus.fr.body: 88e : Carb Loaders poussent mais n’ont eu qu’un tir et 38% de possession ces 5 dernières minutes — trop peu pour revenir. Garde la foi jusqu’à la fin.
player-focus.fr.why: Montre que l’équipe a accéléré tard, mais sans contrôle suffisant : ça n’a pas changé la probabilité de résultat en faveur des Benchwarmers.

player-focus.es.title: Último empuje sin recompensa
player-focus.es.body: A los 88' Carb Loaders han tenido 1 remate y 38% de posesión en los últimos 5 minutos: presión pero sin control para empatar.
player-focus.es.why: Importa porque, aunque Cardoso y el equipo intentan apretar, ese tiempo y ese remate no cambiaron que Benchwarmers ya tuviera el partido asegurado.

player-focus.pt.title: Último empurrão do Carb
player-focus.pt.body: Nos últimos 5 minutos o Carb teve 38% de posse e só 1 remate — pressão, mas pouco para virar o 2-3. Í. Cardoso envolvido nas tentativas finais.
player-focus.pt.why: Mostra esforço final do teu jogador, mas não mudou o resultado: Benchwarmers já controlavam o jogo.

signal.headline: Benchwarmers FC take control: 62% possession and 3.3 passes per possession over the last 5 minutes.

insight.why_it_matters: At 88' Benchwarmers FC are dictating the endgame with 62% possession and steady 3.3 passes per possession, protecting a 3-2 lead and making Carb Loaders chase rhythm rather than create chances.
insight.analyst_note: Benchwarmers FC’s control phase (chaos_index 51.6, turnovers_per_min 1.6) shows managed possession with moderate risk: high overall passes (563) and superior pass accuracy (0.812) reduce Carb Loaders’ ability to press successfully late in the match.

commentary.line: Benchwarmers FC dominate the closing stages — 62% possession and calm control since the 80th-minute goal, squeezing Carb Loaders as they run down the clock.

analyst.en.title: Benchwarmers control the finish
analyst.en.body: At 88' Benchwarmers hold 62% possession, stringing 3.3 passes per possession while using 23.3% long balls to run down the clock and protect a 3-2 lead.
analyst.en.why: This control forces Carb Loaders to chase rhythm, cutting their chance creation and preserving Benchwarmers' win probability in the closing minutes.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Control phase (chaos 51.6, turnovers/min 1.6) with 563 passes and 81.2% accuracy — managed possession reduces successful late presses from Carb Loaders.

analyst.fr.title: Contrôle décisif en fin de match
analyst.fr.body: Benchwarmers FC gère la fin : 62% de possession et 3,3 passes par possession, protégeant un avantage 3-2 et épuisant Carb Loaders.
analyst.fr.why: Cette maîtrise réduit les opportunités de Carb Loaders et verrouille le tempo, consolidant la victoire de Benchwarmers FC.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Phase de contrôle (chaos 51,6 ; pertes 1,6/min) : 563 passes et 81,2% de réussite montrent une possession maîtrisée, limitant l’impact du pressing adverse.

analyst.es.title: Control decisivo de Benchwarmers
analyst.es.body: Con 62% de posesión y 3.3 pases por posesión, mantienen el balón y aseguran el 3-2, reduciendo las opciones de reacción de Carb Loaders.
analyst.es.why: Su dominio final protege la ventaja: niegan ritmo a Carb Loaders y consolidan la victoria al controlar tiempo y balón.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Fase de control con chaos_index 51.6 y 1.6 pérdidas/min: posesión gestionada, 563 pases y 81.2% de acierto limitan la capacidad de presión rival.

analyst.pt.title: Benchwarmers controla o fim
analyst.pt.body: Nos últimos 5 minutos: 62% de posse e 3,3 passes por posse. Dominam o ritmo e fazem Carb Loaders correr atrás do jogo para proteger o 3-2.
analyst.pt.why: Esse controlo no minuto 88 reduz as chances adversárias e preserva a liderança — mudou a dinâmica final a favor dos Benchwarmers.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Fase de controlo com chaos_index 51,6 e 1,6 turnovers/min: posse gerida, alta precisão (0,812) e muitos passes (563) impedem a pressão eficiente do adversário.

signal.headline: Carb Loaders' press pays off: ball won high up and a shot within 0 seconds.

insight.why_it_matters: A high press win in the 89th minute produced an immediate shot (xG 0.06), keeping pressure on Benchwarmers FC and creating a final opportunity to change the score in a tight finish despite win probability already favoring the visitors.
insight.analyst_note: The turnover came from an aggressive high press with zero-pass build-up, converting pressing intensity into a direct shooting chance; Cardoso’s repeated high involvement (7 shots, 33 sprints, top speed 33.3 km/h) shows individual work-rate feeding the team’s late pressing strategy.

commentary.line: Brilliant intensity — Carb Loaders press wins it high and I. Cardoso hammers a 16.6m shot at 95.6 km/h, desperate late response after his 83' goal!

analyst.en.title: High press → instant shot
analyst.en.body: Carb Loaders won the ball high and fired a shot immediately (no buildup). Cardoso took it—another intense press finish pushing until the end.
analyst.en.why: Kept late pressure on Benchwarmers FC and produced a direct chance (xG 0.06) that could've changed the result in a tight finish.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Turnover came from an aggressive high press with zero-pass build-up, converting pressing intensity into a direct shot; Cardoso’s high involvement (7 shots, 33 sprints, 33.3 km/h) underpins the tactic.

analyst.fr.title: Press haut, tir immédiat
analyst.fr.body: Pressing gagnant des Carb Loaders : récupération haute et tir instantané (xG 0,06). Exemple de pressing converti en occasion dans une fin serrée.
analyst.fr.why: Garde la pression sur Benchwarmers FC et crée une ultime opportunité de revenir même si les visiteurs sont favoris.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Récupération par pressing agressif sans passes de construction, transformée en tir direct ; Cardoso montre un fort travail individuel (7 tirs, 33 sprints, 33,3 km/h) au service du plan de pressing tardif.

analyst.es.title: Presión alta, tiro inmediato
analyst.es.body: Robo en campo rival que genera un remate directo (0.06 xG). Cardoso culmina la jugada tras una recuperación sin pases previos.
analyst.es.why: Mantiene la presión sobre Benchwarmers y crea otra opción para empatar en el final, aunque la probabilidad favorecía ya al rival.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Recuperación por presión alta sin fase de construcción; convierte intensidad de press en tiro. Cardoso: 7 remates, 33 sprints y 33.3 km/h, clave en la estrategia final.

analyst.pt.title: Press alto gera remate rápido
analyst.pt.body: Pressão alta aos 89' ganha a bola e I. Cardoso remata imediatamente — oportunidade direta no fim, mantendo a equipa a carregar até ao apito final.
analyst.pt.why: Mantém pressão sobre Benchwarmers FC e cria hipótese final (xG 0,06) para tentar alterar o resultado num fim de jogo tenso.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Turnover por press agressivo sem construções (0 passes), traduzido em remate imediato; Cardoso foi central no padrão, com alta intensidade e participação ofensiva constante.

home-fan.en.title: Late press almost pays
home-fan.en.body: Carb Loaders win the ball high and Cardoso fires a quick shot (tiny chance). Great fight right to the end — still chasing an equaliser.
home-fan.en.why: Kept pressure on Benchwarmers and gave a last chance to change the score in a tight finish.

home-fan.fr.title: Press haut payant
home-fan.fr.body: Pressing gagnant à la 89e : Cardoso récupère et tire immédiatement (bonne occasion). On pousse jusqu'au bout !
home-fan.fr.why: Cette récupération et le tir immédiat ont gardé la pression sur les visiteurs et donné une dernière chance de changer le score.

home-fan.es.title: ¡Presión que casi lo cambia!
home-fan.es.body: Turnover alto en el 89' y Cardoso dispara al instante (xG 0.06). Otra ocasión para los Carb Loaders que apuraron hasta el final.
home-fan.es.why: Mantuvo la presión sobre los visitantes y generó una última oportunidad real para empatar pese a ir perdiendo.

home-fan.pt.title: Pressão dá chance final
home-fan.pt.body: Aos 89', a Carb Loaders roubou a bola lá na frente e I. Cardoso atirou logo — perigo até o fim, ainda bem que não desistiram.
home-fan.pt.why: Mostrou que a equipa ainda atacou até ao fim: um roubo alto gerou um remate imediato (chance pequena), mantendo-nos vivos na luta até ao apito final.

player-focus.en.title: Cardoso wins it high
player-focus.en.body: I. Cardoso nicks the ball up front and fires a shot straight away — late push to pull one back, keeping hope alive despite the scoreline.
player-focus.en.why: Kept pressure on Benchwarmers FC with an instant shot (xG 0.06), creating a last chance to change the game.

player-focus.fr.title: Press haut, tir immédiat
player-focus.fr.body: Cardoso récupère le ballon près du but adverse et tire tout de suite (bonne pression, tir cadré). Toujours là jusqu’au bout — il pousse pour égaliser.
player-focus.fr.why: Cette récupération haute a créé une occasion directe (xG 0,06) et a maintenu la pression pour une possible égalisation en fin de match.

player-focus.es.title: Recuperación alta y tiro
player-focus.es.body: I. Cardoso roba arriba y dispara al instante (xG 0.06). Otro esfuerzo enorme a falta de nada para empatar.
player-focus.es.why: Mantuvo la presión y dio una última oportunidad real para cambiar el marcador, pese a que los visitantes tenían ventaja.

player-focus.pt.title: Pressão alta rende remate
player-focus.pt.body: I. Cardoso recupera a bola perto da área e dispara de pé — remate imediato (xG 0,06). Ainda há vida até o fim; que esforço do teu jogador.
player-focus.pt.why: A recuperação alta criou um remate instantâneo e manteve a pressão para tentar empatar, mesmo com o jogo a favorecer os visitantes.

signal.headline: Carb Loaders' press pays off: ball won high up and a shot within 4 seconds.

insight.why_it_matters: A high press win in the 90th minute led to a quick shot (xG 0.08) inside 4 seconds, showing Carb Loaders could still create danger despite trailing 2-3 and limited possession. The moment sustained late pressure and forced Benchwarmers into risky turnovers.
insight.analyst_note: Pressing win created an immediate transition (build_up_s 4) with only one pass before the shot; J. Albrecht’s involvement (shot and key pass earlier) highlights how forward pressing from the front can generate high-value chances even when overall possession (39.2%) is low.

commentary.line: Brilliant high press — S. de Vries nicks it and J. Albrecht smashes a fierce footed strike within four seconds, a late roar from the Carb Loaders!

analyst.en.title: Late press wins ball
analyst.en.body: Carb Loaders forced a turnover high up and took a shot within 4 seconds — quick transition from press to attempt, despite low possession and trailing 2-3.
analyst.en.why: Kept pressure late and produced a quick chance (xG 0.08), showing they could still create danger and force risky Benchwarmers turnovers.
analyst.en.analyst_note: Pressing win led to an immediate transition (build_up_s 4) with one pass before the shot; Albrecht’s involvement shows forward pressing can create chances despite 39.2% possession.

analyst.fr.title: Pressing gagnant, tir rapide
analyst.fr.body: Pressing haut récupère le ballon et Albrecht arme un tir en 4 s (une passe avant le tir). Poussée tardive malgré 39,2% de possession.
analyst.fr.why: Ce pressing a généré une transition immédiate et un tir (xG 0,08), maintenant la pression tardive et forçant des pertes de balle risquées.
analyst.fr.analyst_note: Win de pressing -> transition en 4 s, une seule passe avant le tir; Albrecht impliqué (tir + passe clé), preuve que le pressing avant crée des occasions malgré faible possession.

analyst.es.title: Presión alta crea tiro rápido
analyst.es.body: La recuperación en campo rival dejó un disparo en 4 s tras una sola conexión; peligro inmediato pese al 2-3 y poca posesión.
analyst.es.why: Mantuvo la presión final y forzó pérdidas arriesgadas del rival, manteniendo viva la opción de marcar pese al marcador adverso.
analyst.es.analyst_note: Victoria de presión desencadenó transición inmediata (build_up_s 4) con 1 pase antes del disparo; Albrecht ya había participado (disparo y pase clave), evidenciando efecto de la presión ofensiva aunque posesión 39.2%.

analyst.pt.title: Pressão alta gera tiro rápido
analyst.pt.body: Roubada alta resultou em remate em 4s (xG 0,08). Transição imediata com só uma passe antes do chute — perigo mesmo com 39,2% de posse.
analyst.pt.why: Mostra que pressão alta ainda cria oportunidades no fim; manteve pressão e forçou turnovers arriscados que sustentaram a jogada perigosa.
analyst.pt.analyst_note: Vitória de pressing gerou transição imediata (build_up_s 4) com 1 passe antes do remate; Albrecht envolvido reforça eficácia do pressing atacante apesar da posse reduzida.

home-fan.en.title: Late press nearly pays off
home-fan.en.body: Carb Loaders win the ball high, shoot within 4 seconds—J. Albrecht forces a save. A real late gasp despite being behind, created danger from nothing.
home-fan.en.why: Kept pressure on Benchwarmers late and showed we could still make chances even with little ball.

home-fan.fr.title: Press payant en fin de match
home-fan.fr.body: À la 90e, pressing haut: récupération et tir en 4s. Albrecht a testé le gardien après une passe clé de S. de Vries — encore du danger malgré la possession faible.
home-fan.fr.why: Ce geste prouve qu’on pouvait encore inquiéter Benchwarmers en fin de match et maintenir la pression, même en étant menés 2-3.

home-fan.es.title: Presión que casi iguala
home-fan.es.body: En el 90' el press dio fruto: balón robado arriba y tiro en 4 segundos. Nos mostró que aún podíamos crear peligro pese a ir 2-3 y sin mucho balón.
home-fan.es.why: Importa porque mantuvo la presión final y forzó errores del rival, demostrando que podíamos generar ocasiones rápidas aunque tuvimos poca posesión.

home-fan.pt.title: Pressão no fim quase dá certo
home-fan.pt.body: Recuperámos a bola alto e, em 4s, J. Albrecht atira ao alvo (rápido, perigoso). Mostrou que ainda havia perigo apesar de estarmos a perder 2-3.
home-fan.pt.why: Mostrou que a equipa continuou a forçar erros do adversário e criou perigo imediato, mantendo pressão tardia que podia ter mudado o resultado.

player-focus.en.title: Albrecht wins it high
player-focus.en.body: Carb Loaders press forces a turnover; J. Albrecht gets the ball and fires a quick shot within 4 seconds after one pass.
player-focus.en.why: Shows your team still created danger late — kept pressure on and forced Benchwarmers into risky mistakes despite trailing 2-3.

player-focus.fr.title: Pressing payant en fin de match
player-focus.fr.body: Carb Loaders récupèrent haut, J. Albrecht tire en 4s après une passe de S. de Vries — une alerte malgré le 2-3.
player-focus.fr.why: Montre que l’équipe a continué à presser et à créer du danger tardivement, forçant Benchwarmers à des pertes risquées.

player-focus.es.title: Presión que obliga al error
player-focus.es.body: Carb Loaders recuperan arriba y, en 4 segundos, J. Albrecht chuta. Demuestra que seguimos creando peligro pese a ir 2-3 y tener menos el balón.
player-focus.es.why: Mantuvo la presión final y forzó un fallo rival, mostrando opciones para empatar al final.

player-focus.pt.title: Pressão alta dá chance rápida
player-focus.pt.body: Carb Loaders recuperam a bola na frente e, em 4 segundos, J. Albrecht dispara à baliza — perigo mesmo com posse curta. Foi pressão até ao fim.
player-focus.pt.why: Mostrou que, mesmo a perder 2-3 e sem muita posse, a equipa continuou a criar perigo e forçar erros do Benchwarmers.

analyst.en.headline: Benchwarmers lead at the break after early set-piece strike
analyst.en.summary: Benchwarmers FC lead 1-0 at half-time courtesy of P. Lozano’s 14' corner finish. Benchwarmers dominated possession (65.2%) and passing (338, 83.4% accuracy), while Carb Loaders have generated heavy momentum swings and more direct threat relative to possession. Carb Loaders’ 34.8% possession but higher pressing effectiveness and recent momentum (91.9 at 32') suggests the second half will be a test of whether they can convert pressure into clear chances. Tactical discipline from Benchwarmers, and finishing from Lozano or a decisive assist from O. Faye, will determine the outcome.
key_moments: 7' Big chance! P. Lozano fires wide from 4 m (xG 0.41).
12' Momentum swings towards Carb Loaders.
14' GOAL! P. Lozano scores for Benchwarmers FC. Carb Loaders 0-1 Benchwarmers FC.
32' Momentum swings towards Carb Loaders.
analyst.en.tactical_story: Benchwarmers have controlled possession and tempo (65.2%, 338 passes, 0.834 accuracy) and converted a set-piece into the lead; Carb Loaders have the momentum and are generating pressure despite limited possession, so the match will tilt on whether they translate that momentum into higher-quality chances. Benchwarmers must protect their spatial compactness and avoid giving up second balls from set plays; Carb Loaders need cleaner link-up play in the final third to raise their low xG (0.46).

analyst.fr.headline: Benchwarmers FC mène à la pause malgré une possession dominée
analyst.fr.summary: Benchwarmers FC mène 1-0 à la mi-temps grâce à l’ouverture de P. Lozano (14'). Malgré 65,2% de possession et 338 passes, les visiteurs n’ont que quatre tirs. Carb Loaders, moins maîtres du ballon (34,8%), ont accru leur influence en fin de première période et poussent pour revenir. Les indicateurs d’espérance (xG) donnent l’avantage aux Benchwarmers (0,99 vs 0,46), mais les momentum swings montrent une Carb Loaders de plus en plus dangereuse.
key_moments: 7' Big chance! P. Lozano fires wide from 4 m (xG 0.41).
12' Momentum swings towards Carb Loaders.
14' GOAL! P. Lozano scores for Benchwarmers FC. Carb Loaders 0-1 Benchwarmers FC.
32' Momentum swings towards Carb Loaders.
analyst.fr.tactical_story: Benchwarmers FC a contrôlé le ballon (65,2%) et imposé un tempo de circulation (338 passes, 83,4% de réussite), cherchant à user l’adversaire; l’ouverture sur corner (14') leur a donné un avantage. Carb Loaders restent dangereux malgré la possession moindre : forte activité dans les phases hautes (ppda 7,3 vs 5,2) et deux basculements de momentum montrent qu’ils trouvent des solutions pour générer du jeu et des opportunités en transition.

analyst.es.headline: Benchwarmers mandan con posesión; Carb Loaders reaccionan al descanso
analyst.es.summary: Benchwarmers FC se van al descanso con ventaja 0-1 tras el gol de P. Lozano al 14'. Dominio claro en posesión y pases (65.2% y 338 pases) para Benchwarmers, pero Carb Loaders han elevado su momentum y generan peligro pese a menos control. Estadísticamente, Benchwarmers tienen mayor xG (0.99 vs 0.46) y mejor precisión de pase (0.834), mientras Carb Loaders compensan con más intención vertical y presión alta en fases clave.
key_moments: 7' Big chance! P. Lozano fires wide from 4 m (xG 0.41).
12' Momentum swings towards Carb Loaders.
14' GOAL! P. Lozano scores for Benchwarmers FC. Carb Loaders 0-1 Benchwarmers FC.
32' Momentum swings towards Carb Loaders.
analyst.es.tactical_story: Benchwarmers han impuesto un control posicional (65.2% posesión, 338 pases, PPDA 5.2) para dominar el tempo y generar xG; Carb Loaders responden con transiciones y mayor intensidad en zonas altas (momentum a su favor en varios tramos), buscando explotar espacios detrás de la presión pasiva de Benchwarmers.

analyst.pt.headline: Benchwarmers levam vantagem no intervalo apesar da reação dos Carb Loaders
analyst.pt.summary: Benchwarmers FC domina posse (65,2%) e circulação, abriu o placar cedo com P. Lozano e controla o ritmo. Carb Loaders respondeu em momentos — métricas de momentum favorecem-nos em janelas do jogo — mas criaram menos perigo segundo xG (0,46). Carb Loaders reagiu no segundo tempo e forçou nervosismo até ao fim, mas o golo de Faye aos 80' praticamente selou a vitória.
key_moments: 51' Momentum swings towards Carb Loaders.
55' GOAL! P. Lozano scores for Benchwarmers FC. It's a brace! Carb Loaders 0-2 Benchwarmers FC.
58' Huge save! G. Ojeda denies L. Castagne (xG 0.72, 88 km/h).
66' GOAL! L. Castagne scores for Carb Loaders. Carb Loaders 1-2 Benchwarmers FC.
80' GOAL! O. Faye scores for Benchwarmers FC. Carb Loaders 1-3 Benchwarmers FC.
83' GOAL! I. Cardoso scores for Carb Loaders. Carb Loaders 2-3 Benchwarmers FC.
away-fan.pt.tactical_story: Benchwarmers controlou o jogo com mais posse (61.2%) e mais passes precisos, deixando a equipa gerir o ritmo; arrancos decisivos de Faye e Lozano fecharam espaços. Carb Loaders tentou pressão e mudança de abordagem com menos longos depois do 74', mas não teve tempo para completar a reviravolta.

player-focus.en.headline: Cardoso's late fight not enough as Benchwarmers hold on
player-focus.en.summary: I. Cardoso starred for Carb Loaders with a goal and an assist in a 2-3 loss to Benchwarmers FC. Benchwarmers controlled possession and punished chances—P. Lozano scored twice and O. Faye created and finished the decisive third. Carb Loaders had bursts of momentum and tactical tweaks that produced two goals, but Benchwarmers' control after 74' and the 80' strike sealed the win.
key_moments: 51' Momentum swings towards Carb Loaders.
55' GOAL! P. Lozano scores for Benchwarmers FC. It's a brace! Carb Loaders 0-2 Benchwarmers FC.
66' GOAL! L. Castagne scores for Carb Loaders. Carb Loaders 1-2 Benchwarmers FC.
80' GOAL! O. Faye scores for Benchwarmers FC. Carb Loaders 1-3 Benchwarmers FC.
83' GOAL! I. Cardoso scores for Carb Loaders. Carb Loaders 2-3 Benchwarmers FC.
player-focus.en.tactical_story: Benchwarmers dominated possession and controlled tempo (61.2% possession, 600 passes), while Carb Loaders targeted quicker transitions and reduced long balls after the 74th minute—Cardoso’s set-piece finish punished a late push but Benchwarmers’ possession and the 80' goal protected their lead.

player-focus.fr.headline: Cardoso brille mais Benchwarmers tiennent
player-focus.fr.summary: I. Cardoso a réduit l'écart deux fois dans la seconde période et a été déterminant sur coup de pied arrêté, mais Benchwarmers FC ont fini par l'emporter 3-2. Benchwarmers ont dominé la possession (61,2%) et contrôlé le tempo, O. Faye a fait la différence avec un but et deux passes décisives. Match riche en rebondissements: égalité manquée par Carb Loaders après des vagues de momentum inversées, puis but décisif d'O. Faye à la 80e.
key_moments: 51' Momentum swings towards Carb Loaders.
55' GOAL! P. Lozano scores for Benchwarmers FC. It's a brace! Carb Loaders 0-2 Benchwarmers FC.
66' GOAL! L. Castagne scores for Carb Loaders. Carb Loaders 1-2 Benchwarmers FC.
80' GOAL! O. Faye scores for Benchwarmers FC. Carb Loaders 1-3 Benchwarmers FC.
83' GOAL! I. Cardoso scores for Carb Loaders. Carb Loaders 2-3 Benchwarmers FC.
player-focus.fr.tactical_story: Benchwarmers ont dominé la possession et le jeu de passes (600 passes, 81% de réussite), contrôlant le match malgré des poussées des Carb Loaders qui ont changé de style après la 74e (moins de longs ballons). Les interventions décisives en seconde période, et la capacité d'O. Faye à exploiter les espaces, ont scellé la victoire.

player-focus.es.headline: Cardoso brilla pero Benchwarmers se llevan la victoria
player-focus.es.summary: I. Cardoso tuvo un gran partido: gol y asistencia para intentar rescatar a los Carb Loaders, que cayeron 2-3 contra Benchwarmers FC. A pesar de dominar menos la pelota, los Carb Loaders reaccionaron tras el 0-2 y pusieron emoción al final. O. Faye fue decisivo para los visitantes con gol y dos asistencias y se llevó el premio a MVP.
key_moments: 51' Momentum swings towards Carb Loaders.
55' GOAL! P. Lozano scores for Benchwarmers FC. It's a brace! Carb Loaders 0-2 Benchwarmers FC.
66' GOAL! L. Castagne scores for Carb Loaders. Carb Loaders 1-2 Benchwarmers FC.
80' GOAL! O. Faye scores for Benchwarmers FC. Carb Loaders 1-3 Benchwarmers FC.
83' GOAL! I. Cardoso scores for Carb Loaders. Carb Loaders 2-3 Benchwarmers FC.
player-focus.es.tactical_story: Carb Loaders generaron más tiros (19) y xG (4.0) pese a tener solo 38.8% de posesión; cambiaron a menos balones largos tras el 74' para construir, lo que les permitió marcar dos goles en la segunda mitad pero no evitar la eficacia de Benchwarmers en control y pases (600, 81% precisión).

player-focus.pt.headline: Cardoso brilha num empate sofrido
player-focus.pt.summary: I. Cardoso marcou o segundo golo dos Carb Loaders e foi o destaque do seu time numa recuperação que quase deu certo. Benchwarmers FC controlou mais a posse e teve os momentos decisivos, com P. Lozano a bisar e O. Faye a fechar o resultado. No fim, 3-2 para Benchwarmers FC num jogo de viragens e emoção até ao apito final.
key_moments: 51' Momentum swings towards Carb Loaders.
55' GOAL! P. Lozano scores for Benchwarmers FC. It's a brace! Carb Loaders 0-2 Benchwarmers FC.
66' GOAL! L. Castagne scores for Carb Loaders. Carb Loaders 1-2 Benchwarmers FC.
80' GOAL! O. Faye scores for Benchwarmers FC. Carb Loaders 1-3 Benchwarmers FC.
83' GOAL! I. Cardoso scores for Carb Loaders. Carb Loaders 2-3 Benchwarmers FC.
player-focus.pt.tactical_story: Benchwarmers FC dominou com mais posse (61.2%) e passes precisos, controlando o jogo; Carb Loaders reagiu mudando o estilo (menos bolas longas) e criou pressão, mas não foi suficiente para virar o resultado. A defesa dos Benchwarmers resistiu aos momentos finais após o golo de Cardoso.

en.headline: Solid start from the keeper
en.summary: G. Ojeda has been calm and efficient with his feet so far, completing 2 of 4 passes and making 2 recoveries in a quiet 15 minutes. Missing a save or any involvement in shot-stopping so far — no saves recorded yet.

fr.headline: Gardien solide mais discret
fr.summary: G. Ojeda a gardé sa cage propre et a été propre au pied: peu de tirs à repousser, 2 passes complétées sur 4. Manque d'intervention sur coups dangereux (0 arrêts, peu d'interventions) mais l'équipe domine le jeu en possession.

es.headline: Portero tranquilo, poco exigido
es.summary: G. Ojeda ha tenido un inicio sobrio: 15 minutos en campo con apenas 4 pases y sin paradas. Bien en control básico pero necesita más protagonismo en juego con los pies (solo 2 pases completados) y cero intervenciones defensivas hasta ahora.

pt.headline: G. Ojeda tranquilo até agora
pt.summary: Gonzalo Ojeda teve atuação discreta e segura nos 15 minutos: pouco trabalho, passes curtos e duas recuperações. Falta saída com os pés mais confiante (apenas 2 passes completados) e nenhuma defesa registrada — ainda sem intervenções em remates.

en.headline: Quiet but tidy midfield start
en.summary: D. Assunção has kept things simple: six passes (5 completed) and one progressive carry in 15 minutes, helping Benchwarmers control possession. Missing attacking impact — no shots, key passes or pressures yet. Solid positioning but needs more forward influence for a No.10.

fr.headline: D. Assunção discret mais propre
fr.summary: D. Assunção reste mobile et précis sur ses passes: 6 passes dont 5 réussies, beaucoup de passes progressives. Manque d'influence offensive (0 tirs, 0 passes clés) et peu d'interventions défensives jusqu'à présent.

es.headline: Control medio con pocas oportunidades
es.summary: D. Assunção ha manejado el balón con calma y ha pasado bien (5/6), pero aún sin disparos, claves ni impactos defensivos claros en estos 15 minutos. Su presencia creativa queda por materializarse dentro del área y en pases de ruptura.

pt.headline: Silencioso mas controlando jogo
pt.summary: D. Assunção tem controlado passes curtos e progressão, com poucas ações de ataque — sem remates ou passes-chave ainda. Falta-lhe mais presença na área e combinações ofensivas para justificar a 10.

en.headline: Active creator in midfield
en.summary: O. Faye has set the tone with an assist and accurate passing, creating chances from midfield. Good involvement and pressing, but no shots or dribbles yet — could get more into the box as the game progresses.

fr.headline: Bon départ, passe décisive brillante
fr.summary: O. Faye a délivré une passe décisive en 15 minutes et joue proprement au milieu (bonne précision de passes). Peu de tirs et d'actions individuelles dans la surface — il manque des tentatives vers le but.

es.headline: Buen inicio creativo y preciso
es.summary: O. Faye ha asistido y ha tenido buena influencia en el ataque: precisión en el pase y dos pases clave. Le falta presencia en remate y entradas defensivas más constantes para su rol de mediocentro.

pt.headline: Bom começo e assistência precoce
pt.summary: O. Faye tem sido influente: já deu a assistência do gol e fez passes progressivos eficazes, com boa precisão. Ainda faltam remates e presença mais próxima da área para criar perigo direto.

en.headline: Quiet but tidy midfield start
en.summary: S. Hendriks has kept ball well in a low-risk first 15 minutes: 16 passes with 88.9% accuracy and six progressive passes. Missing are any forward attempts or defensive actions — no shots, key passes or tackles yet.

fr.headline: Discret mais propre au milieu
fr.summary: S. Hendriks a touché beaucoup de ballons propres et a bien fait circuler (16 passes, 89% de réussite). Il manque d’impact offensif (0 tirs, 0 passes clefs) et peu de duels défensifs pour un milieu central.

es.headline: Control en el medio temprano
es.summary: S. Hendriks ha contribuido con pases seguros y juego progresivo sin brillar en ataque: 16 minutos, 18 pases y 6 pases progresivos. Le falta presencia en remates, recuperaciones y acciones defensivas más contundentes.

pt.headline: Calmo, controlando o meio
pt.summary: S. Hendriks tem participado com passe seguro e progressivo, completando 16 de 18 passes e 6 passes progressivos. Ainda sem remates, desarmes ou recuperações no jogo; pode aparecer mais nas transições ofensivas mesmo com a posse alta da equipa.

en.headline: Solid start at right-back
en.summary: I. Moraes has been tidy defensively with early pressing and one recovery, completing his only two passes. Lacks touches forward — no key passes or progressive plays yet — but no fouls or cards so far after 15 minutes.

fr.headline: Solide mais discret en défense
fr.summary: I. Moraes a bien tenu sa zone: 15 minutes, 2 passes propres et 1 récupération, sans fautes. Manque d'influence offensive et d'interceptions pour se démarquer davantage en défense centrale.

es.headline: Sólida presencia defensiva temprana
es.summary: I. Moraes ha mantenido seguridad: pocas pérdidas y buena conducción (1 recuperación, 2 pases completados). Le falta participación en zonas de ataque y acciones defensivas más decisivas (0 intercepciones, 0 despejes). Cumple por ahora como defensor, necesita más duelos y pases largos.

pt.headline: Seguro, mas pouco envolvido
pt.summary: I. Moraes tem cumprido o básico na defesa: poucas ações ofensivas e apenas 2 passes em 15 minutos. Está sólido sem faltas nem cartões, mas precisa aparecer mais no jogo e aumentar recuperações e intercepções para justificar a titularidade.

en.headline: Steady defensive presence so far
en.summary: B. Villalba has been reliable early: two simple passes completed and two recoveries, covering 1.54 km with six sprints. Missing are tackles or interceptions inside defence and more involvement in build-up; no bookings.

fr.headline: Solide mais discret en défense
fr.summary: B. Villalba a bien tenu sa zone: 15 minutes, 2 passes complétées et 2 récupérations. Peu impliqué offensivement (0 passes clés, 0 tirs) et aucun tacle/interception — il manque de duels défensifs gagnés pour vraiment briller.

es.headline: Buen arranque defensivo
es.summary: B. Villalba lleva 15 minutos y cumple en defensa: 2 recuperaciones y precisión en sus 2 pases. Poco involucrado en ataque (0 pases clave, 0 intercepciones) y todavía sin entradas al área rival; necesita más conexiones con el equipo pese al 65.7% de posesión.

pt.headline: Defesa calmo e presente no apoio
pt.summary: B. Villalba fez um começo tranquilo: pouco envolvimento ofensivo (2 passes) mas seguro defensivamente, com 2 recuperações e 6 sprints. Ainda falta maior participação na construção e mais passes para justificar posse alta da equipa.

en.headline: Solid start from the right-back
en.summary: N. Steiner has been steady defensively with limited ball involvement — only 2 passes so far — helping his team protect a 0-1 lead. Missing more passes and tackles/interceptions; needs to get into the game more when possession-heavy Benchwarmers build out from the back.

fr.headline: Défenseur discret mais propre
fr.summary: N. Steiner a été solide défensivement sans erreurs visibles: peu de touches et très peu de passes (1 réussite), mais aucune intervention défensive notée. Manque d'influence offensive et d'interceptions pour un défenseur à ce stade (16e).

es.headline: Defensa con poco juego
es.summary: N. Steiner ha estado sólido físicamente pero casi no participa en el juego: pocas entregas y ninguna acción defensiva registrada. Su pase preciso falta (solo 1 completado) y le vendrían bien más intervenciones cerca del área rival o recuperaciones.

pt.headline: Silêncio defensivo de N. Steiner
pt.summary: Niklas Steiner teve participação razoável mas discreta: poucos passes e nenhuma intervenção defensiva até agora. Cumpriu corrida e velocidade, mas falta envolvimento defensivo no jogo — quase sem toques em zonas perigosas nem desarmes.

en.headline: Quiet but steady defensive start
en.summary: J. Thackeray has been tidy with his passing (3/3) and mobile (1.48 km, top speed 27.7 km/h) in the first 15 minutes. Little defensive involvement so far — no tackles or interceptions and no touches in the box yet. Solid positioning, but needs more challenges to justify the lead.

fr.headline: Solide mais discret en défense
fr.summary: J. Thackeray a bien tenu sa position: 15 minutes, 3 passes complétées et une passe progressive. Peu de relais offensifs et aucune intervention défensive statistique (tacles/interceptions 0) — manque d'engagement défensif mesurable pour un défenseur.

es.headline: Sólida pero poco involucrado
es.summary: J. Thackeray juega seguro como defensa: pases precisos y buen ritmo, pero casi sin intervención defensiva en 15 minutos. Le faltan entradas, intercepciones o recuperaciones cerca del área rival.

pt.headline: Seguro, mas pouco envolvido
